description:
B2B SaaS Account Executive – Full Sales Cycle (US Market)



Remote – Philippines | Full-Time | Base Salary + Uncapped Commissions





ABOUT REPUTATIONSTACKER



ReputationStacker is an established US-based SaaS company helping businesses generate more customer reviews, manage their online reputation, and turn customer feedback into actionable business insights.



Our platform includes automated review requests, review monitoring, sentiment analysis, AI-powered review replies, and multi-location reporting.



We're hiring an experienced B2B salesperson to independently build a pipeline of US business prospects and convert them into paying customers.



IMPORTANT: This is a full-cycle sales position with a strong emphasis on outbound prospecting. We do not provide warm leads or prequalified appointments.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You'll own the entire sales process, from identifying prospects to closing deals.



• Develop your prospecting strategy: Identify promising customer segments, research target businesses, find decision-makers, and continually refine your outreach approach.



• Generate your own pipeline: Proactively engage US businesses through outbound calls, personalized
s, LinkedIn, and other effective channels.



• Build relationships and create demand: Understand prospects' challenges, establish credibility, and demonstrate how ReputationStacker can benefit their businesses.



• Conduct demos and close sales: Qualify prospects, present the software, handle objections, negotiate, and convert opportunities into paying customers.



• Manage and optimize your pipeline: Track activity and opportunities in our CRM, follow up consistently, and improve conversion rates.



• Collaborate on larger deals: Work with company leadership when additional support would help close substantial or complex opportunities.



Our primary targets include small and midsize businesses, multi-location operators, franchise groups, and regional chains.



Leadership can assist with larger deals, but you'll be responsible for developing opportunities to the point where prospects understand the product, its value to their business, and approximate pricing before any handoff.



Success is measured by paying customers and revenue generated—not appointments booked.





COMPENSATION & EARNING POTENTIAL



Base salary: $1,200–$1,800 USD/month, depending on experience, plus uncapped commissions.



• 15% of first-year collected subscription revenue for deals you independently close.



• 7.5% of first-year collected subscription revenue for opportunities you originate and substantially develop that company leadership closes.



• Commissions include additional locations activated by your customers during their original 12-month commission period.



Our average subscription revenue is approximately $100 per business location per month.



Examples of first-year commissions for a single independently closed customer:



• 1 location = $180 commission

• 10 locations = $1,800 commission

• 25 locations = $4,500 commission

• 50 locations = $9,000 commission



Commissions are in addition to your base salary and paid as customer revenue is collected. Examples assume 12 months of payments, with no cancellations or discounts. Actual earnings depend on sales results and customer retention.





WHAT WE OFFER



• An established SaaS product with an existing customer base.

• Product training, demo access, sales materials, and CRM/outreach tools.

• Freedom to develop and refine your own prospecting strategy.

• Direct collaboration with experienced US-based company leadership.

• Customer onboarding and ongoing support handled by our team.

• Long-term growth potential, including increased responsibilities and compensation based on performance.





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably selling SaaS, software, digital marketing, or recurring business services to US customers.



• Proven success independently generating prospects and personally closing deals you originated. Appointment-setting experience or closing company-provided leads alone does not qualify.



• Strong outbound prospecting, relationship-building, discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.



• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence communicating directly with US business owners and executives.



• Experience conducting live software demos and using CRM and sales outreach tools.



• Self-directed, resourceful, organized, and accountable for results.



• Full-time availability with substantial overlap during US Pacific business hours.



• Reliable internet and a professional environment for customer calls.



Experience selling to franchises or multi-location businesses is a significant advantage.





HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume/CV and LinkedIn profile (if available).



2. Your sales background: What products or services have you personally sold to US businesses?



3. Two specific B2B deals you've personally originated AND closed. For each, describe:



   • What you sold and the approximate deal value.

   • Who the buyer was.

   • How you identified and initially contacted the prospect.

   • How you developed the opportunity and closed the sale.

   • The approximate length of the sales cycle.



4. Your prospecting approach: How would you independently identify and approach potential US customers for a review-management SaaS platform, especially businesses with multiple locations?



5. A 1–2 minute video introduction describing your relevant experience and why you'd be successful in this role.



Finalists should be prepared to provide professional references or other reasonable verification of prior sales results.



Include "Full-Cycle Sales" in the subject line or first line of your application.



Applications without evidence of personally originating and closing B2B sales, or without a video introduction, will not be considered.



We're looking for an accomplished salesperson who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch, developing business relationships, and closing deals—and wants to be rewarded for the revenue they generate.

title: KDP Publishing & Book Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly skilled, creative, and results-driven KDP Publishing & Book Marketing Manager to oversee the publishing, promotion, and growth of fiction books, particularly in the psychological thriller and suspense genres.



The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully marketing and selling books on Amazon, managing advertising campaigns, and executing effective strategies to increase book visibility, readership, and profitability.



This is not simply a book uploading or administrative role. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn published books into commercially successful products through strategic marketing, compelling content, and data-driven decision-making.



You will manage the publishing process from manuscript preparation to launch while developing and executing ongoing marketing campaigns.



Key Responsibilities

1. Book Marketing & Amazon Advertising (Primary Focus)

- Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase book sales, readership, and visibility.

- Manage and optimize Amazon Ads campaigns, including automatic, keyword, and product-targeting advertisements.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, costs, sales, and estimated royalties to evaluate profitability.

- Research relevant book categories, keywords, competing titles, and target audiences.

- Optimize Amazon book listings, descriptions, metadata, and discoverability.

- Write persuasive book descriptions, promotional copy, advertising headlines, and
 campaigns.

- Develop marketing strategies for book series, backlist titles, and new releases.



2. Social Media & Audience Development

- Create engaging promotional content for TikTok (BookTok), Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Develop short-form videos, promotional graphics, and creative marketing materials.

- Identify and collaborate with relevant book influencers, reviewers, and content creators.

- Build and maintain reader
 lists, newsletters, and book launch campaigns.

3. Amazon KDP Publishing & Production

6. Performance Tracking & Reporting

- Track book sales, advertising costs, royalties, and marketing performance.

- Analyze campaign results and recommend improvements.

- Maintain organized publishing records, campaign data, and project timelines.

- Submit weekly progress reports outlining completed tasks, campaign results, spending, challenges, and upcoming priorities.



Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in Amazon KDP publishing and book marketing.

- Demonstrated success marketing and promoting published fiction books.

- Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Amazon Ads campaigns.

- Strong understanding of book marketing strategies, audience targeting, keyword research, and Amazon discoverability.

- Excellent written English with strong copywriting and editorial skills.

- Experience creating engaging social media marketing content and short-form promotional videos.

- Ability to analyze advertising performance, sales reports, and marketing profitability.

- Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work independently.

- Proactive, detail-oriented, creative, and results-driven.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience marketing psychological thrillers, suspense, mystery, or other full-length fiction genres.

- Familiarity with BookTok, Bookstagram, and influencer marketing.

- Experience with
 marketing platforms and reader audience development.



Knowledge of ebook and paperback formatting tools.

- Experience coordinating book cover design and marketing graphics.

- Familiarity with Amazon Author Central and A+ Content.

- Experience using AI-assisted writing and marketing tools.

- Background in fiction writing, manuscript editing, or creative publishing.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate actual book marketing results, not just experience uploading books to Amazon.

title: Job Description – Remote Fitness Assessor
description:
Job Vacancy – Remote Personal Training Assessor & Course Administrator



Company: Course Delivery Heroes

Position: Level 2 Gym Instructor & Level 3 Personal Trainer Assessor

Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Working Hours: 40 Hours Per Week – Full-Time

Industry: International Fitness Education & UK-Regulated Qualifications

Students: Based Across the UK and Worldwide



About Course Delivery Heroes



Course Delivery Heroes supports the delivery of professional fitness education and qualifications to students across the UK and around the world.



We work with training providers to deliver high-quality online learning, practical assessments and professional qualifications.



We are looking for an experienced fitness professional based in the Philippines to join our growing international team.



You will support students from different countries, cultures and backgrounds who are studying towards UK Level 2 Gym Instructor and Level 3 Personal Trainer qualifications.



This is a full-time role combining fitness assessment, student support, qualification administration and online course development.



About the Role



Your primary responsibility will be reviewing and assessing students' practical exercise videos, programme cards, PDF assignments and written coursework.



A strong understanding of human movement, exercise technique, biomechanics and ACSM exercise guidelines is essential.



You must be confident identifying incorrect exercise techniques, evaluating movement patterns and providing clear, constructive feedback.



Much of the role involves reviewing PDF documents and providing feedback directly within the PDF or through our online learning platform.



You will be supporting an international student community. Excellent written English, cultural awareness and the ability to communicate clearly with students from different backgrounds are therefore essential.



When assessment workloads are lower, you will assist with student administration, qualification tracking and digital course development.



Key Responsibilities



1. Practical Exercise & Movement Assessment



Review videos submitted by students worldwide demonstrating exercise techniques and personal training sessions.



Assess movement quality, posture, joint alignment, range of motion and exercise execution.



Identify incorrect techniques, movement compensations and potential safety concerns.



Evaluate squats, lunges, deadlifts, presses, pulls and other resistance exercises.



Assess cardiovascular, resistance and flexibility training techniques.



Review exercise progressions and regressions.



Evaluate coaching skills, exercise instruction and corrective feedback.



Apply recognised ACSM guidelines and evidence-based exercise principles.



Ensure assessments meet the relevant UK qualification criteria.



2. PDF Assessment & Written Feedback



A significant part of this position involves reviewing student submissions and providing detailed feedback.



You will:



Open, review and mark PDF assignments.



Provide comments, annotations and corrections directly on PDF documents.



Highlight areas where students have not met assessment criteria.



Clearly explain what students need to improve.



Review programme cards, consultation forms and nutritional assignments.



Evaluate written coursework against assessment criteria.



Record assessment decisions and upload feedback through our online learning platform.



Provide professional, encouraging and constructive feedback to international students.



Excellent IT skills are essential, particularly in PDF editing, annotation, online assessment platforms and digital document management.



3. Personal Training Programme Assessment



Review Level 2 gym-based exercise programmes.



Assess Level 3 personal training programme design.



Evaluate exercise selection, sets, repetitions, intensity, rest periods and training frequency.



Check programmes against individual client needs, goals and abilities.



Assess exercise progression, regression and adaptation.



Review ACSM exercise prescription guidelines.



Assess client consultations, health screening and risk assessments.



4. Anatomy, Physiology & Nutrition Assessment



Mark anatomy and physiology assignments.



Assess students' understanding of musculoskeletal movement and biomechanics.



Review exercise science and training principles.



Evaluate nutrition consultations and dietary recommendations.



Assess lifestyle advice, behaviour change and client education.



Provide evidence-based, constructive written feedback.



5. International Student Support & Qualification Administration



Support students studying from different countries and time zones.



Monitor learner progress across Level 2 and Level 3 qualifications.



Track outstanding assessments, resubmissions and course completion.



Update student records and qualification tracking systems.



Respond professionally to international student enquiries.



Support learner enrolment and onboarding.



Maintain accurate assessment and qualification documentation.



Assist with quality assurance and certification administration.



Communicate effectively with students whose first language may not be English.



6. Online Course Creation & Development



When you are not assessing student work, you will support our course development team.



Responsibilities include:



Creating and updating online course materials.



Uploading educational content to Moodle or similar platforms.



Creating quizzes, knowledge checks and assessments.



Supporting interactive H5P learning activities.



Formatting and reviewing PDF learning resources.



Updating existing courses and qualification content.



Supporting educational content development and general administration.



Essential Skills & Qualifications



Applicants must demonstrate:



A recognised personal training qualification equivalent to UK Level 3 or above.



Strong knowledge of human movement, biomechanics and exercise technique.



Good working knowledge of ACSM exercise testing and prescription guidelines.



The ability to identify poor exercise technique and recommend appropriate corrections.



Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, nutrition and exercise programming.



Experience reviewing exercise programmes and training plans.



Excellent IT skills, including PDF editing and online assessment systems.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong communication skills when working with international students.



Cultural awareness, patience and a supportive approach to learner feedback.



Good organisational and administrative skills.



Confidence working independently and managing multiple responsibilities.



Reliable internet access and a suitable computer.



Availability for 40 hours per week.



Desirable Experience



Previous experience as a fitness assessor, tutor or educator.



A recognised assessor qualification, such as CAVA, A1 or equivalent.



Familiarity with UK Level 2 and Level 3 personal training qualifications.



Experience assessing practical exercise videos.



Knowledge of Moodle, H5P or similar platforms.



Experience with Adobe Acrobat or other PDF annotation tools.



Previous experience supporting students internationally.



Experience in educational administration or digital course development.



Important: Successful applicants must meet the relevant UK awarding organisation's assessor competence and approval requirements before independently making formal assessment decisions for regulated qualifications.



Working Hours & Location



40 Hours Per Week – Full-Time



This is a fully remote position for applicants based in the Philippines.



You will work with our UK-based education team while supporting students studying from locations across the world.



Your working week will be divided between student assessment, administration and online course development.



Working schedules and any required overlap with UK business hours will be agreed during recruitment.



Career Development



We want to recruit someone who becomes a valued, long-term member of Course Delivery Heroes.



As our business and international student community continue to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your role further in assessment, course creation, quality assurance or team leadership.



As we grow, your role can grow with us too, if that is something you would like.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys helping students succeed and wants to contribute to a forward-thinking international education business.



How to Apply



Please submit your CV and complete our application form.



We would like to know:



What personal training or fitness qualifications do you hold?



How familiar are you with ACSM exercise guidelines?



Can you confidently assess exercise technique and identify movement errors?



Have you previously marked fitness assignments or practical exercise videos?



Are you experienced in reviewing, annotating and providing feedback on PDF documents?



Which PDF editing and online learning platforms have you used?



Have you worked with UK qualifications or training providers?



Do you have experience supporting international students?



Are you confident providing written feedback in English to students worldwide?



Do you have experience in course administration or online course creation?



Are you available to work 40 hours per week?



What is your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos (PHP)?



Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical assessment task, which may involve reviewing an exercise demonstration video, marking a personal training programme card and providing written feedback on a PDF assignment.



Join the Course Delivery Heroes Global Team and help us support the next generation of fitness professionals across the world.

title: Construction Project Coordinator/Project Manager

Who is Team RRE?

We are team players who prioritize open communication while exercising emotional control. We do the right thing and are dedicated to winning. We are not perfect—we learn from our mistakes in the process of being great.



Team RRE Core Values

We Are Team Players

To be the greatest nationwide, relationship-based electrical contractor with the best culture for our team members.

Strong, winning Team culture

Access to company health plan (Kaiser Permanente)

Retirement plan

Position Overview

This role serves as a central communication hub between Project Managers, field team members, vendors, clients, and general contractors. Extreme organization, proactive communication, emotional control, and a strong desire to help Team RRE win are required.



Why PC/PM?

We want you to grow here and develop your project management skills. Start thinking and working like a Project Manager by understanding not only where the project stands today, but also where it will be by the end of the month. By reviewing billings, labor hours, material purchases, schedules, and project completion percentages, you'll gain a better understanding of project forecasting, cost control, and overall project performance.

Business licenses

Receive incoming job-related
s and route critical requests to the Project Manager per direction.

Schedule status

Labor hours and production

Risks, constraints, and next steps

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist / Seller Closer — 2 Hires | Part-Time or Full-Time
description:
REIMate is hiring TWO experienced acquisitions specialists to personally call US homeowners, negotiate approved purchase offers, and get qualified single-family purchase contracts signed.



PAY AND HOURS

Base pay: $4 USD/hour. Part-time and full-time applicants welcome: 20–40 hours/week Monday–Friday. Tell us your preferred hourly, fixed salary, or base-plus-bonus arrangement. Performance bonuses can be discussed; no commission-only requirement. US business-hours availability is required, including 9am–1pm US Eastern; the full daily schedule will be agreed before hiring. Philippine hours change with US daylight saving time.



THE WORK

Use the triple dialer inside our REIMate app to call homeowner lists. Our software also handles initial SMS outreach. You personally qualify sellers, understand motivation/condition/timeline/price, present approved cash offers, handle objections, and guide owners through purchase signatures. Follow up consistently on interested sellers and unsigned contracts. Keep accurate CRM notes and communicate with sellers through closing, including dates, questions and approved addendums. Work within our buy box and approved pricing. Qualified contracts must be for single-family houses and signed by the owner on title.



REQUIRED

At least 2 years calling US homeowners for a wholesaler or investor, with personal seller negotiation and purchase-contract experience. Clear, natural spoken English and the ability to listen and handle objections in a live conversation. Quiet workspace, stable internet, headset and dependable attendance. You must personally do the work.



HELPFUL

REsimpli, xLeads, real-estate SMS CRMs, Batch Dialer, CallTools, Mojo, ReadyMode or similar dialers. We can teach our app; you should already understand homeowner conversations and follow-up.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the last US city where you personally got a homeowner to sign a purchase contract.

2. Briefly describe a difficult seller negotiation, your own role, and what you said that moved it forward.

3. State your personal last-90-day numbers: signed purchase contracts, cancellations, and funded/closed deals; include lead source and approximate lead volume. Separate houses from land and personal results from team totals. If a number is unavailable, say so.

4. Attach your resume and, if you have permission to share it, a short seller-call sample or recording link. Do not share confidential seller information.

5. Give your preferred pay structure and minimum guaranteed pay, earliest start date, and availability for 20–40 hours/week during US hours.



SELECTION

A short interview includes a seller role-play: your offer is too low, followed by an unsigned-contract follow-up. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for an investor reference and a paid trial on approved leads/offers, with terms agreed in advance. We assess negotiation, qualified contracts, follow-up accuracy and seller outcomes. We are hiring people currently seeking work who can personally join our team.

title: Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems
description:
Job Description:

This is more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

We're looking for a seasoned culinary leader who can oversee and strengthen an entire culinary operation — from products and recipes to food quality, food safety, training, systems, and profitability.

You'll diagnose urgent product and quality problems, build the systems and standards needed to fix them, and create a culinary operation that can maintain consistent quality even as the business grows, locations change, and people come and go.



This is a fully remote leadership role. Dedicated on-site Head Chefs handle day-to-day kitchen execution. Your focus is on the culinary standards, systems, processes, and leadership that keep multiple locations and concepts consistent and profitable.





What You'll Own:



Lead and strengthen culinary operations across multiple locations, concepts, and teams

Assess products, menus, recipes, suppliers, and production processes using data, reports, and remote evidence

Diagnose and direct fixes for taste, consistency, quality, and food-safety issues

Work through on-site Head Chefs and culinary leaders to ensure standards are executed consistently

Build controlled recipes, specifications, production standards, and processes with clear tolerances and version control

Standardize culinary systems across restaurants, commissary/central kitchen, bakery, catering, and other food operations as needed

Lead menu engineering — improve, reposition, standardize, or remove underperforming products

Establish food-safety, quality, and traceability systems, including root-cause analysis

Build training, development, and succession systems for culinary teams

Own the culinary drivers of food cost, yield, waste, consistency, and margin

Use technology, data, and AI to improve culinary decision-making, communication, and operational control

Create systems that preserve culinary knowledge and maintain continuity despite team turnover







What We're Looking For:



10+ years of progressive culinary/F&B leadership experience, ideally at Executive Chef, Culinary Director, Corporate Chef, or equivalent level

Significant experience leading multi-location, multi-concept, or complex hospitality/F&B operations

Strong practical culinary background across different cuisines, products, and operating environments

Working knowledge of bakery and pastry operations, including products, recipes, production processes, and quality standards

Proven ability to restore product quality and build repeatable culinary systems — not just cook well

Experience with recipes, specifications, SOPs, production standards, quality control, and training systems

Comfortable leading and directing kitchen execution remotely through on-site culinary leaders

Strong understanding of food cost, yield, waste, portion control, and labor economics

Experience with food safety, quality assurance, and traceability

Strong systems, technology, data, and communication skills

Advanced, practical use of AI and modern digital tools

Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance culinary quality with profitability



Bonus Points:



Experience across multiple cuisines, concepts, brands, or dayparts

Commissary, central kitchen, bakery, catering, or large-scale food production experience

Beverage operations or dining service experience

Experience leading distributed or remote culinary teams

Experience building training and succession pipelines

Experience standardizing culinary operations during growth, restructuring, or expansion



You'll Thrive Here If You...



Believe quality should survive turnover, distance, and growth — not depend on one person's memory

Can lead and influence experienced kitchen teams without being physically present

Bring both deep culinary expertise and strong systems/technology thinking

Balance exacting culinary standards with real commercial judgment

Enjoy diagnosing problems and building practical solutions

Want to build a culinary system that is consistent, scalable, and sustainable — not simply run a kitchen





Benefits:



HMO / Health Insurance

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Additional Leave

Work from Anywhere / Work from Home

Performance-Based Pay Raises

title: Executive Virtual Assistant I Business Systems & Administration
description:
Australian Residential Building Company | Part-Time with Growth Opportunity



ABOUT US



McDowell Homes is a boutique, family-owned residential building company based in New South Wales, Australia.



We specialise in custom homes, dual occupancies, boutique developments and Class 2 projects throughout Newcastle, the Hunter Valley and Port Stephens.



We're a small, hands-on team with high standards, and we're looking for an experienced, organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to work closely with our Business Manager.



This isn't a basic data-entry or general admin position.



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys creating order, improving systems, documenting processes and making a busy business run more efficiently.



You'll play an important role in helping us organise and streamline our business operations, with the opportunity to grow into broader responsibilities over time.



THE ROLE



The initial focus will be business systems, administration, document management and process development.



You'll work closely with our Business Manager to implement resources and systems from The Professional Builder (TPB), develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), organise our digital files and improve everyday administrative workflows.



As you become familiar with our business, you'll gradually take on additional responsibilities, including
 management, accounts administration, marketing support and eventually construction project administration within Wunderbuild.



We want someone who can become a reliable, long-term part of our team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



BUSINESS SYSTEMS & SOP DEVELOPMENT



Work through TPB training materials, resources and templates to assist with implementing business improvements.



Create, document, format and maintain clear, practical Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Turn existing processes, notes, recordings and instructions into organised, easy-to-follow procedures.



Develop checklists, templates, forms and workflow documents.



Help establish consistent systems across our business.



Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve administrative processes.



Maintain an organised SOP library and ensure documents remain current.



GOOGLE WORKSPACE & FILE MANAGEMENT



Organise, restructure and maintain Google Drive folders and documents.



Assist with our ongoing transition from Dropbox to Google Drive.



Establish and maintain consistent file naming conventions and folder structures.



Create and format professional documents in Google Docs and Google Sheets.



Manage shared files, permissions and document versions.



Keep digital records accurate, organised and easy to locate.



Identify duplicate, outdated or incorrectly filed documents.



 & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION



Assist with monitoring, organising and managing business
s.



Categorise enquiries, flag priorities and prepare draft responses.



Follow up outstanding correspondence, documentation and administrative tasks.



Maintain contact records, registers and business information.



Assist with scheduling, reminders and general business coordination.



Support our Business Manager with day-to-day administrative tasks.



XERO & ACCOUNTS SUPPORT



Assist with organising supplier invoices, receipts and financial documentation.



Support accounts payable and receivable administration.



Assist with invoice follow-ups and record keeping.



Maintain accurate supporting documentation.



Help ensure financial information is correctly organised for review.



This is an administrative support role, not a dedicated bookkeeping position.



CANVA & MARKETING SUPPORT



Create and update branded documents, presentations and templates in Canva.



Assist with preparing social media graphics and marketing materials.



Maintain consistent branding across business documents.



Organise marketing assets, images and templates.



Assist with scheduling and preparing marketing content as required.



FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES



As you become familiar with McDowell Homes and our systems, the role may expand to include:



Wunderbuild project administration and document management.



Maintaining project records, schedules and client documentation.



Supplier and subcontractor administration.



Assisting with onboarding and compliance documentation.



Supporting our construction and estimating team with administrative tasks.



Additional business improvement projects.



ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



You must be highly proficient in:



Google Workspace — particularly Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs and Google Sheets.



Dropbox — file organisation, sharing and document management.



Xero — practical experience with invoices, records and general accounts administration.



Canva — creating and editing professional branded documents and graphics.



We are looking for someone who also has:



At least 3 years' experience in an Executive VA, Business Administration, Operations Support or similar role, preferably within a residential building company



Demonstrated experience creating SOPs, documenting processes or organising business systems.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.



Confidence managing multiple tasks and priorities.



The ability to work independently, use initiative and follow tasks through to completion.



Excellent computer skills and confidence learning new software.



A proactive, solutions-focused attitude.



Reliable internet, a suitable home office and the ability to work with confidential business information.



IMPORTANT: We need someone who is already confident and capable with the essential software listed above. This is not a role for someone who needs to learn Google Workspace, Dropbox, Xero or Canva from scratch.



HIGHLY REGARDED



Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:



Australian construction or residential building businesses.



The Professional Builder (TPB) resources or implementation processes.



Wunderbuild or other construction project management software.



Business process improvement and workflow automation.



ChatGPT, Claude or other AI productivity tools.



Google Forms and Google Sheets-based trackers.



Social media scheduling and content administration.



Working directly with Australian business owners or senior managers.



Previous construction industry experience is desirable but not essential. Strong systems, administration and organisational skills are more important for this particular role.



THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You'll be someone who:



Loves turning messy folders, scattered information and inconsistent processes into organised systems.



Notices when something is missing or doesn't make sense.



Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told every little step.



Asks thoughtful questions instead of making assumptions.



Can take a broad instruction and turn it into a finished, professional result.



Enjoys learning how a business operates and finding better ways to do things.



Is comfortable working closely with a business owner in a small team.



Wants a stable, long-term position with opportunities to grow.



We're not looking for someone who simply ticks tasks off a list. We want someone who helps us build better systems and keep them running.



HOURS & WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



Remote position — Philippines-based applicants welcome.



Initially approximately 20 hours per week.



Flexible working arrangement with regular overlap during Australian Eastern business hours.



Opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities as the role develops.



Long-term position for the right person.



Remuneration will be based on experience, demonstrated skills and suitability.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include "MH Systems" in the subject line of your application.



If you have practical experience creating SOPs or implementing business systems, add "SOP" immediately after "MH Systems" in your subject line.



Your application must include:



A brief introduction explaining why you're suited to this role.



Details of your experience supporting Australian businesses.



Your level of proficiency with Google Workspace, Dropbox, Xero and Canva, including examples of how you've used each.



Your experience developing SOPs, documenting processes or improving business workflows.



An example of a system, filing structure or administrative process you've personally improved.



Any experience with construction businesses, TPB, Wunderbuild or AI productivity tools.



Your availability, preferred working hours and expected hourly rate in AUD.



Your current CV and, if available, examples of SOPs, templates or Canva documents you've created.



TECHNICAL SCREENING QUESTION



Imagine you've joined our business and discover the following:



Business files are spread across Dropbox and Google Drive.



Several documents have multiple versions with inconsistent names.



Important procedures exist only in
s, handwritten notes or verbal instructions.



The Business Manager is spending too much time searching for information and following up administrative tasks.



What are the first five steps you would take to organise the information, establish clear systems and begin creating SOPs? Explain why you would approach the task in that order.



We are particularly interested in your practical thinking, organisational skills and ability to work independently.



OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview.



Successful candidates may then be asked to complete a paid practical assessment involving Google Workspace, document organisation and SOP development.



We value attention to detail, initiative, clear communication and demonstrated ability over impressive-sounding job titles.



If you're an organised, capable and proactive VA who loves creating efficient systems and wants to become a valued part of a growing Australian building business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



A note on AI: we build AI products, so we recognize AI-generated writing immediately. Any application or answer written by AI will be discarded without a reply. We want to hear from you, in your own words.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers,
, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use NinjaOne RMM for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Manage SentinelOne endpoint security, including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone,
, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**  

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.

title: B2B Partnerships
description:
About Hatsy



Hatsy is a US headwear brand making the best hat in the world: every hat is lined with silk, which is better for hair, scalp and skin, and more comfortable than anything else on the market. Our tagline is Inside Matters. We're content- and community-driven, and we're expanding into a full headwear line.

Until now we sold online only. With our supply chain now solved, we're opening a brand-new B2B channel — and we see it as one of the biggest drivers of awareness and revenue for Hatsy going forward.



The role



We're hiring an experienced B2B Partnerships Manager to build and own Hatsy's US B2B channel from the ground up. You'll find, pitch, close, onboard and manage two types of partners: service centers (dermatology clinics, hair salons, wellness centers) and retailers (department stores like Nordstrom and Bloomingdale's, boutiques, mall stores).

The core of this role is finding and closing the right partners. Hatsy is a premium brand, and every location that carries us reflects on it. You'll source partners that match our brand — reputable, well-reviewed, upscale or design-led businesses, never low-tier or off-brand locations — reach them through every channel including the phone, represent Hatsy the way we would, and close the deal. We need someone who already understands the US B2B market deeply and has done exactly this before.

This is a full-time, fully remote position working US hours. You'll report directly to the founders. Our initial focus markets are New York, Los Angeles and Miami, where we have team members who can visit partners in person when needed.



What you'll own



1. Service center partner portals

Service centers — dermatology clinics, hair salons, hair-loss specialists, wellness centers and spas — recommend Hatsy to their clients after a treatment or service, as a better alternative to the hat they'd usually wear.

Each partner gets one display set of hats (one of each style) and its own branded page on our website, for example 
/portals/drdorfman, with custom hero images of their location. Clients try a hat on in person, then buy through the portal. The partner holds no inventory and handles no payments, and clients can browse the full range.

You'll be the lead on this program end to end: finding and pitching centers, closing them, onboarding them (display set, portal setup, staff talking points), and monitoring each partner's performance.



2. Retail placement

The goal is to put Hatsy in front of everyday consumers in physical stores — department stores (Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's), independent boutiques, concept stores and mall retailers — ideally with our own section and branded name card.

Here we ship stock to the store. You'll research and prioritize accounts, find the right buyers, pitch and negotiate, and manage the relationship through first order, sell-through and reorders. Your job is to convince them that Hatsy is the superior hat and belongs on their floor.



Responsibilities

Prospecting & research

• Build and maintain target lists of service centers and retailers in New York, LA and Miami, then expand to other US cities.

• Identify decision-makers (owners, practice managers, buyers, category managers) and their contact details.

• Vet every account for brand fit (reputation, reviews, clientele, look and feel) before reaching out, then prioritize by size and likelihood to close.



Outreach & closing

• Run multi-channel outreach, including cold calling locations directly by phone, plus
, LinkedIn, Instagram DMs and wholesale platforms.

• Write and refine pitch
s, call scripts and follow-up sequences.

• Lead video calls and presentations; handle objections and negotiate terms.

• Book in-person visits for our local team and brief them before each one.

• Prepare for and pursue department store buyer meetings and vendor onboarding processes.



Onboarding

• Service centers: coordinate the display set shipment, collect photos and details for their portal, work with our web team to launch it, and train staff on how to recommend Hatsy.

• Retailers: manage line sheets, purchase orders, shipping, in-store display and name card setup.



Account management & reporting

• Monitor sales per partner (portal sales and retail sell-through) and flag under-performers early.

• Run regular check-ins, drive reorders and grow each account.

• Keep the CRM complete and up to date — every lead, touchpoint and deal stage.

• Send a weekly pipeline report to the founders: new leads, meetings, deals closed, revenue by partner.

• Feed back what you hear from partners on product, pricing and objections.



Who we're looking for

Must-haves

• 3+ years in B2B sales, wholesale or partnerships, selling to US businesses — with closed deals you can point to.

• Strong knowledge of the US retail landscape: how department stores, boutiques and independent shops buy, and how to reach their buyers. You can tell a premium, on-brand location from a low-tier one at a glance.

• Proven ability to open doors cold: you've booked meetings with businesses that had never heard of your company, and you're comfortable cold calling locations by phone.

• Persuasive, native-level English, written and spoken, and the polish to represent a premium brand in every
, call and meeting. You're confident on the phone and on camera with American business owners.

• Extremely organized. You live in your CRM, track every follow-up and never let a lead go cold.

• Self-managed and reliable working remotely: you set your own daily targets, hit them and report clearly without being chased.

• Available to work US Eastern Time business hours.



Strong pluses

• Experience selling fashion, accessories, apparel or beauty products wholesale in the US.

• Experience selling into salons, dermatology clinics, med spas or wellness businesses.

• Existing relationships with US department store or boutique buyers.

• Familiarity with wholesale platforms (Faire, NuOrder, Joor) and department store vendor onboarding.

• Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM, Apollo or similar prospecting tools, and Shopify.

• Comfortable building partner-facing materials in Canva or Google Slides.



You'll fit in if you're

• Competitive and driven by results, not activity.

• Genuinely excited by building something new from zero.

• Proud of the product you sell — you'll need to believe Hatsy is the best hat on the market.



What success looks like

First 30 days

Set up; 150+ qualified targets across NY, LA and Miami; pitch materials and outreach sequences live; first meetings booked

First 60 days

First service center portals live; first retail conversations and samples out

First 90 days

30+ service center portals live and selling; 5+ retail accounts signed; a weekly reporting rhythm the founders rely on

Longer term, you'll grow this into a repeatable channel across the US and a meaningful share of Hatsy's revenue.



Schedule & compensation

• Type: full-time, remote

• Hours: US Eastern Time business hours, Monday to Friday

• Salary: $1,500 USD per month

• Quarterly bonus: performance-based quarterly bonuses, with targets set together in your first month

• Start: as soon as possible

• Equipment: reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, quiet space for calls, webcam and headset



How to apply

We receive many applications, so please follow these steps exactly — applications that skip them won't be reviewed.

1. Start your application with the subject line "Inside Matters – B2B".

2. Tell us about one US B2B deal you closed: who the buyer was, how you got the meeting and what you sold.

3. List the US companies or types of businesses you've sold to, and your typical results (meetings per month, deals closed, revenue).

4. Include your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test task and a video interview with the founders.

title: Architectural Drafter / BIM Modeler — U.S. Projects | Part-Time to Start
description:
We are seeking a reliable architectural drafter/BIM modeler for remote, part-time work on a paid trial basis, with potential for full-time work. Excellent spoken and written English and familiarity with U.S. architectural and construction terminology are essential.



You should have experience producing U.S. architectural construction documents, models, and details, preferably for residential, school, and healthcare projects. We need someone who understands wood framing, steel studs, structural steel and metal buildings, concrete, and CMU—not just how to draw them. You should follow good industry practices for drawing standards, model organization, coordination, and quality control.



Software experience we’re looking for:



• AutoCAD: Plans, elevations, sections, details, external references, layouts, and dynamic blocks.

• Revit: Full architectural BIM models, construction documents, schedules, families, and detailing.

• Vectorworks: Architectural drawings, BIM models, sections, details, and organized sheet production.

• SketchUp: Preliminary architectural design and 3D models, particularly designs that can be brought into Revit and developed into native BIM elements.

• Twinmotion: Architectural renderings and walkthroughs.



Experience with BOTH Revit and Vectorworks is especially valuable. Tell us if you have used them together and how you exchanged or coordinated files. Also describe any projects where you developed a preliminary SketchUp design into a Revit model and construction documents.



You must communicate consistently, meet agreed deadlines, provide realistic time estimates and progress updates, and work using your own capable computer, software, and reliable internet.



To apply, please send:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your project and construction experience.

2. For each program above: the version you currently have, years of professional experience, skill rating from 0–10, and a brief description of work you’ve done with it. List other relevant software as well.

3. Three to five work samples, including construction drawings and details. Identify the portions you personally completed and remove confidential information.

4. Your computer specifications (processor, RAM, graphics card, storage, and operating system) and internet download/upload speeds, with a recent speed-test screenshot.

5. Your available hours and schedule in Philippine time, earliest start date, and expected hourly rate and currency.

6. Your contact Microsoft Teams ID.  This is the program we use to communicate



Shortlisted candidates may be offered a paid skills assessment. The paid part-time trial will help us evaluate drawing quality, construction knowledge, communication, and reliability.

title: Travel Agent Servicing Canadian Clients
description:
Travel Sales Closer & Vacation Advisor (North American Shift) – High Commission + Base Pay ($600–$800 USD/mo)

Job Overview:

SunClub Travel & Rewards is an established Canadian travel agency. We are rapidly expanding our operations with our new proprietary AI booking concierge, Captain Sunny, and we need a dynamic, articulate, and hungry Travel Sales Closer to take incoming qualified warm leads across the finish line over the phone.

Read This Carefully Before Applying: We are not looking for a data-entry clerk, an
 typist, or someone who hides behind
 Messenger sending endless text quotes. Our AI already handles initial trip research and quotes. Your job is to pick up the phone, build trust, review curated itineraries live with Canadian travelers, and collect the booking deposit.

If you are intimidated by picking up the phone and closing sales, please do not apply.

If you have a clear speaking voice, love travel, know how to steer a conversation to a closed deposit, and want to earn substantial uncapped performance commissions on top of guaranteed base pay, this is your dream role.

Key Responsibilities:

Close Inbound Warm Leads on the Phone: Transition leads generated by our marketing and AI concierge into scheduled phone consultations (outbound dialing to booked appointments and fast follow-ups).

Consultative Selling: Walk Canadian clients through custom cruise, all-inclusive, and tour packages; present unadvertised perks, upgrades, and SunClub Rewards privileges to close deposits on the call.

Proactive Follow-up Pipeline: Maintain a tight follow-up system with prospects who requested consultations—calling them back until a definitive decision is reached.

Supplier Booking & Admin: Finalize reservations with major Canadian and global travel suppliers, process payments securely, and deliver travel documentation.

Client Retention & Advocacy: Serve as the client's dedicated personal travel advocate before departure and follow up post-trip for rebooking and referrals.

Mandatory Qualifications (Do Not Apply Without These):

1. Minimum 2 Years of Proven Sales Closing Experience: You must have a demonstrable track record of selling over the phone and asking for the sale/credit card. Preference given to applicants with previous Canadian experience. 

2. Impeccable Verbal & Written English: Neutral North American accent or easily understandable, clear, and highly engaging telephone presence.

3. North American Working Hours: Must be fully committed to working full-time on Pacific/Eastern Standard Time (Canadian business hours) with consistent, reliable attendance.

4. Phone Confidence: Zero phone reluctance. You view the phone as your primary closing weapon, not chat apps.

5. Home Office Setup: High-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps with backup option), noise-canceling headset, and a quiet, distraction-free home office environment.

Huge Pluses (Preferred):

Direct prior experience booking with Canadian suppliers (e.g., Sunwing, Air Canada Vacations, WestJet Vacations, Transat, TravelBrands, Expedia TAAP, major cruise lines). We are members of Travel Leaders Consortium

Familiarity with travel booking CRM systems

Compensation & Perks:

Starting Base Salary: $600 – $800 USD per month (based on depth of experience and Canadian supplier knowledge).

Uncapped Sales Commissions: Earn tiered commission on closed bookings and travel package add-ons. High performers can significantly multiply their base pay.

Warm Inbound Leads: No cold calling. Leads are generated through our digital media channels, direct-response ads, and our proprietary AI platform.

Full Training & Scripts: Complete access to our consultative closing framework, supplier training, and direct support from management.

Long-Term Career Growth: Stable full-time position with an established Canadian travel enterprise.

HOW TO APPLY (Strict Screening Step):

We receive hundreds of generic applications. To prove you pay attention to detail and have the verbal communication skills required for this phone-closing role, you must follow these instructions:

1. Change the subject line of your application to:

"I Am Your Next Travel Closer – [Your Full Name]"

2. Record a 60-to-90 second audio recording (using 
, Loom, or a shareable Google Drive link) answering these two questions:

Why do you prefer selling over the phone instead of messaging apps or
?

What was the most exciting vacation package you personally sold or experienced, and how did you get the customer to say YES?

3. Include a link to your resume and briefly list the specific travel suppliers, booking engines, or GDS platforms you have used.

Applications that do not include the audio link or use the incorrect subject line will be deleted immediately without review.

title: Guest Experience and Operations Coordinator

About the Role

You will manage guest communications during your assigned shift, coordinate cleaning and maintenance, keep reservations and room status accurate, and help the team resolve issues promptly. This is a long-term, full-time role with the opportunity to grow into a leadership position.



Our PMS Transition

We currently use Cloudbeds and are migrating to Guesty, with completion expected around late November 2026. You should expect to use Cloudbeds when you start and Guesty as the migration is completed. Guesty experience is our priority; Cloudbeds experience is a plus. If you have not used Cloudbeds, you must be willing to learn it and work in both systems during the transition.



Work Schedule

This role requires flexibility to work different shifts based on hotel coverage needs, rather than one fixed shift. You must be available for scheduled morning, afternoon, evening, or overnight shifts, including weekends and holidays as needed. Shift times will be coordinated in Myrtle Beach time (U.S. Eastern Time). Please include your availability and any scheduling restrictions in your application.



Responsibilities

Guest Service

• Manage guest messages and inquiries across Airbnb, 
, Expedia, Vrbo, and other booking channels during your assigned shift.

• Handle booking confirmations, changes, and cancellations accurately.

• Resolve guest concerns professionally and escalate urgent issues to management or the appropriate team member.

• Monitor arrivals and departures, assist with check-in, and prepare clear end-of-shift reports for the next team member.

• Respond promptly to lockouts and other time-sensitive requests, following established procedures.

Operations

• Coordinate cleaning assignments, track room readiness, and follow up on quality checks.

• Schedule maintenance with on-site staff and vendors, document issues, and track completion.

• Manage reservations, guest communications, billing records, and room status in Cloudbeds during the transition and in Guesty after migration.

• Maintain property checklists, records, and standard operating procedures.

• Support RemoteLock access management and coordinate troubleshooting when guest codes fail.

• Prepare reports on turnovers, maintenance, and daily operations.

• Communicate clearly with other VAs and on-site staff to ensure tasks are completed and shifts are handed over smoothly.



Requirements

• Hands-on experience using Guesty for daily operations is required, including reservations, guest messaging, and operational workflows.

• At least two years of experience in short-term rental, hotel, or property management operations.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Experience communicating with guests through Airbnb, 
, Vrbo, Expedia, or similar booking platforms.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize urgent guest and operational issues.

• Reliable internet connection, a suitable computer, and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Experience

• Previous experience as an operations coordinator or property management VA for a boutique hotel or short-term rental business.

• Cloudbeds experience, especially managing reservations and guest communications. This is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Marketing Coordinator and Video Content Specialist (Full-Time, US CPA Firm)
description:
Fagan + Fagan is a US accounting and tax firm that has served high-income individuals and family-owned businesses for 50 years. We're building a marketing program from the ground up, and we need one self-directed marketer to own it day-to-day.



This is not a task-taker role. We're looking for someone who spots opportunities, proposes ideas, and pushes work forward without waiting to be told. You'll recommend content, campaigns, and improvements; the owner reviews and approves them, and then you execute and report on results. You'll also turn new inquiries into booked consultations. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who wants real ownership and takes pride in quality work.



This is an independent contractor position, not employment. You'll be paid as a contractor and will handle your own taxes and government contributions (BIR, SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG).



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Plan and recommend

- Propose a monthly content calendar for video, blog,
, and social, with topics that matter to high-income individuals and business owners.

- Suggest new lead magnets, campaigns, and channel ideas, along with how you'd measure them.

- Review results each month and recommend what to do more of, change, or stop.

- Submit plans and drafts for approval, then move them forward on schedule without needing reminders.



Create and publish

- Write content for our website, blog,
 newsletter, and social media.

- Create lead magnets, such as tax checklists, short guides, and planning worksheets. Write the content and design them in Canva.

- Build and run Mailchimp drip campaigns that nurture new leads and deliver our lead magnets, and track open and click rates.

- Edit short videos (30 to 90 seconds) of our presenter. Add captions, branded graphics, music, and a clean intro and outro.

- Publish videos on YouTube with titles, descriptions, tags, and custom thumbnails.

- Cut and schedule short-form clips for LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.

- Create Canva graphics that follow our brand: charcoal, green, and white.

- Manage our Google Business Profile with weekly posts and photo updates, and draft review responses for approval.



Manage leads and appointments

- Respond to new leads (website inquiries, Google Business messages, social messages, and
) within 1 business hour. Answer basic questions and book a consultation with the owner. Pass any tax or accounting questions to the owner. You won't give tax advice.

- Screen out spam and vendor pitches from real prospects.

- Book consultations directly on the owner's calendar through our booking page. Send confirmations and day-before reminders, and handle reschedules and cancellations.

- Follow up with leads who haven't booked yet, contact no-shows to rebook, and keep every lead's status up to date in our CRM.

- Keep our referral partner list up to date, send outreach
s, and schedule first meetings with referral introductions.



Report

- Send a short weekly report: what you shipped, results (views,
 performance, reviews, new leads, and consultations booked), what's next, and anything you need approved.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 2 years of marketing or content experience for US clients, including work you planned and led yourself, not only tasks you were assigned

- Self-starter who proposes ideas, manages their own priorities, and follows through without close supervision

- Proven content writing experience (blog posts,
s, or social copy). Writing samples are required.

- A reliable computer, a stable internet connection, and a backup power or internet plan



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with Mailchimp or another
 marketing platform, including automated drip campaigns

- Appointment-setting or lead-response experience for US businesses

- Experience with HubSpot or another CRM

- Previous work for accounting, legal, financial, or other professional-services firms

- Experience with Google Business Profile management

- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or AI avatar video platforms to work faster



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, full-time contract work with a respected, established firm

- Pay in USD, with performance bonuses for strong work

- Real ownership: your ideas get heard, approved, and put into action

- Direct work with the owner, with fast feedback and clear approvals

- Room to grow into a larger marketing role as the program expands



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message through OnlineJobs.ph with:

, or lead magnet you wrote

- Create Visual Masterpieces: Resize, cut out, and composite images to create eye-catching graphics that complement your video content.

- Meet Deadlines & Deliver on Expectations: Take ownership of project timelines and ensure your content is delivered on time, meeting or exceeding expectations.

title: mobile + web + back end developer
description:
**ATTENTION **

Please read to the bottom of this job post for instructions on how to apply for the position



** INTRODUCTION TO MORNING HERO**



Hi, My name is Jarvis and I'm the Morning Hero! Before I tell you about this awesome opportunity, let me first tell you a little about me and my company. 



I wake up at 5am with vibrant energy ready to DOMINATE every single day!! I am probably the happiest, healthiest, and most fulfilled person in the world :-) But it wasn’t always this way… 5 years ago, I was not happy with my life. I wasn't making the income that I wanted... I was overweight... and I always felt "stressed out". I just felt stuck in my life. This lead to me abusing drugs and alcohol to numb myself from my unhappiness. Eventually, I lost everything. I got fired from my job, me and my girlfriend separated and I had to move into my friends basement. I was at a rock bottom.



I new I wasn't living up to my full potential in life. I knew that I meant for greatness! That’s when I became OBSESSED with personal development. I read a book called "The Miracle Morning" that introduced me to the power of waking up early with a structured morning routine. 

 

I started waking up at 5 am every day to work on my goals. Within 30 days, My life completely transformed! I started my own business, I got down to the best shape of my life, and I asked the woman of my dreams to marry me. It was unbelievable how fast my life transformed from this simple concept... wake up early and set my intentions every morning for what I want in life, and then take action to get it! Every MORNING, I would do this routine and I turned into a HERO. Every MORNING, I turned into a HERO… and that’s how the MORNINGHERO was born! 



Now my passion and purpose is to help millions of people become MORNING HEROES so they can live up to their full potential and have all the success and happiness that they deserve in life! I believe that we can end depression and substance abuse by helping people WIN EVERY.DAMN.DAY! 



When everyone lives up to their true greatness in life, the world will be a much better place. And that's our mission at the MorningHero... to inspire everyone to live in their true greatness so the whole world can be uplifted and elevated! 



At the Morning Hero… we are truly trying to make the world a better place. So if this resonates with you.... let’s go, we’ve got work to do!! 

 

** THE ROLE **



I am currently writing a book that breaks down the Morning Hero Framework of how to WIN your day. It goes like this... everyday, there are 5 big things that you should accomplish to have a WINNING day. 



1. Heart Rate - raise your heart rate by doing some Exercise

2. Eating right

3. Read

4. ONE BIG THING (towards your biggest goal)

5. Spread Joy



I call these, "The HERO'S Habits" because the first letter of each habit spells the word HERO'S. Every time you complete a habit, you get a star ??. The goal is to have a 5 star day! 



I want to build a mobile app to help people take score on their day each day (like a habit tracker). 



Each morning, they will go into the app to set their intentions for a 5 star day. They will simply state what action they will take for each habit (ie. Heart rate - I will run 2 miles). Once their intentions are set, they must complete each item to have a WINNING day. at the end of the day, they will take score and see how many stars the achieved. 



They will accumulate points and they can see their score on a leaderboard compared to all the other Morning Hero's in the system. This will motivate them to stay at the top of the leaderboard!



They can also form accountability groups so they can see their score compared to everyone in their group. 



The goal is for the app to "gamilfy" their success habits. I want it to feel like a game (like the Duolingo app). They get points and awards for hitting certain milestones (like a 7 day "hot streak"). 



The "game" should be very visual with fancy animations when they get a 5 star day so they feel proud and accomplished. This will motivate them to keep getting 5 star days. 



This will be primarily used on mobile, but we also need a web interface. Each person will have a dedicated Coach and the coach can pull up the leaderboard for everyone that's in their group. The coaches conduct a daily accountability call with everyone in their group and they will pull up the group leaderboard during their group call. This will be over zoom, so the coach will need to be able to pull up the leaderboard in a web browser to show everyone on zoom.



eventually, I see the app needing to integrate with a calendar so when the user identifies their 5 critical actions (they can schedule them on their calendar). this is a "nice to have" feature but not necessary for the MVP



I'm looking for someone who can help me build each piece of this puzzle... back end, web front end and mobile app. 



We will need to work close together as we nail down the requirements and the features of the app. We will meet at least once each week to go over progress. This meeting will happen at 6am PST so you will need to be available during that time.



Awesome! Here's a draft for the "Requirements" section of your app developer job description, tailored to the needs of your project:



---



### Requirements



**Technical Skills:**

**Experience in Mobile App Development:**

 - Proficiency in building mobile apps and web apps

 - Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX design principles to create engaging, user-friendly interfaces.



**Backend Development:**

 - Expertise in backend technologies

 - Experience with cloud services (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) for hosting and database management.

 - Proficient in database design and management



**Integration and API Development:**

 - Experience in developing and integrating APIs.

 - Knowledge of third-party integrations, such as calendar APIs, for future feature expansions.



**Problem-Solving:**

 - Ability to think critically and solve complex technical challenges.

 - Proactive in identifying potential issues and implementing solutions.



**Nice to Have:**

- Previous experience in gamification and developing habit-tracking or motivational apps.

- Experience in creating engaging animations and visual effects to enhance user experience.



**Availability:**

- Must be available for weekly meetings at 6 am PST.

- Flexibility to accommodate the evolving needs of the project as we iterate and improve the app.



**Additional Requirements:**

- A passion for helping people build positive habits and achieve their goals.

- A proactive attitude and a willingness to take ownership of the project from start to finish.







** THE REQUIREMENTS **

**The ideal person for this role would meet the following requirements:



**Speaks good English. We be talking a lot so we must be able to understand each other.



**Responsive. We will use Slack for team communications. When a request comes in from either myself or someone else on the team, you will need to respond quickly 



**Problem Solver with a “Figure it out” attitude. We have a BIG VISION at the Morning Hero and have many projects that we are working on (a book, a tv show, a mobile app, etc.) Many of these projects are new territory for us. You will need to be able to dive in and help us figure out how to make these happen. Even if it’s something that you don’t know how to do… you must have a “figure it out” attitude to get the job done!





** HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION **



If you believe that you are a great fit for #TeamMorningHero, then here's what you should do next: 



1. Film a video of yourself answering these questions

 - Why do you want to be apart of team Morning Hero?

 - How would you build the app that I described in the description?

 - How long would something like this take to build?

 

2. Send an email to 
 with these items:

 - The video from step 1

 - Your resume

 - Your portfolio of previous development projects





YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED IF YOU DO NOT FOLLOW THESE TWO STEPS EXACTLY!



Thank you for considering this job. It’s an important one. The work that we are doing will change millions of lives! I look forward to reviewing your application!
