title: 🎬 Creative Video Editor | Viral Lifestyle Content | The Morning Hero
description:
# 🎬 Creative Video Editor | Viral Lifestyle Content | The Morning Hero



**Help us inspire the world to live a Five-Star Life! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**



We're looking for a highly creative, talented video editor to join **The Morning Hero**, a growing personal development and lifestyle movement on a mission to inspire people to wake up to their full potential and live a Five-Star Life.



**This isn't your typical video editing job.**



We're not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together, adds captions, and calls it a day.



We're looking for a **creative storyteller** who can turn ordinary, everyday moments into extraordinary, inspiring, scroll-stopping content that people want to watch, share, and experience for themselves.



### 🌟 The Mission



At The Morning Hero, we believe a Five-Star Life is built one Five-Star Day at a time.



Our philosophy is centered around five daily habits we call the HEROS:



⭐ **Heart Rate:** Move your body and get stronger.



⭐ **Eat Right:** Fuel your body and your mind.



⭐ **Read:** Learn, grow, and become better.



⭐ **One Big Action:** Make meaningful progress toward your biggest goals.



⭐ **Spread Joy:** Create happiness and meaningful connections with others.



We want to show the world what this lifestyle looks like in real life.



Not through lectures. Not through advertisements.



**Through stories that inspire people to say, "I WANT THAT LIFE!"**



### 🎥 What You'll Be Doing



I'll be documenting my daily lifestyle and uploading raw video footage into organized, shared folders.



This footage will include:



- Early morning routines and workouts

- Healthy meals and nutrition

- Reading, learning, and personal growth

- Building a business and pursuing big goals

- Spending quality time with my wife and kids

- Adventures, fun, and meaningful life experiences

- Behind-the-scenes moments of living a Five-Star Life



**Your job is to turn this footage into compelling, viral-style short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.**



You'll have the creative freedom to:



- Find powerful stories hidden within everyday footage

- Develop attention-grabbing hooks that stop the scroll

- Combine multiple clips into engaging lifestyle montages and mini-stories

- Use music, sound design, transitions, text, and effects to create emotion

- Identify viral editing styles and creatively adapt them to our brand

- Experiment with new concepts, formats, and storytelling techniques

- Subtly integrate The Morning Hero app into the content when appropriate



The goal isn't simply to get views.



**The goal is to make people WANT to live a Five-Star Life and inspire them to download The Morning Hero app to start their own journey.**



### 🚀 Who We're Looking For



You might be a great fit if you:



- LOVE creating short-form, viral-style content.

- Understand what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.

- Have a strong sense of storytelling, pacing, emotion, and music.

- Know how to transform raw lifestyle footage into compelling narratives.

- Follow trends on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

- Can take creative ownership without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Are comfortable working independently from shared footage folders.

- Have experience editing cinematic lifestyle, fitness, motivational, or personal-brand content.

- Can balance beautiful visuals with engaging, high-retention storytelling.

- Are excited about health, personal growth, entrepreneurship, and living life to the fullest.



**Most importantly, we want someone who brings IDEAS, not just editing skills.**



We want you to watch the footage and say, "I have an amazing idea for a video!"







### ❤️ Why Join The Morning Hero?



We're building something bigger than a social media account.



We're building a movement.



The Morning Hero app helps people develop five powerful daily habits that lead to greater health, happiness, productivity, financial growth, and fulfillment.



Your work will help introduce thousands of people to a lifestyle that could genuinely change their lives.



You'll have creative freedom, ongoing content to work with, and the opportunity to grow with a mission-driven brand.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term creative partner, not just complete a few editing projects.



### 📩 How to Apply



1. Record a video of yourself answering the question "Why do you want to work for Morning Hero?"

2. Send your video submission to 



We may invite shortlisted candidates to complete a short, paid creative editing test using footage from The Morning Hero.



**If you love storytelling, creativity, and inspiring people to become the best version of themselves, we'd love to hear from you.**



Let's inspire the world to wake up and WIN EVERY DAMN DAY! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

 design and web/landing page visuals

title: Project manager and QA coordinator (Remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company | Immediate start



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for an organised, confident project manager to take ownership of our projects from sales handover through to completion and final payment.



We typically have around 40 active projects at different stages. We need someone who keeps jobs moving, follows through and makes sure the required checks happen before work proceeds.



This is a remote coordination and management role. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must understand construction project delivery and be comfortable working with drawings, specifications and quality records.



You will work closely with our design, procurement, installation and accounts teams. You must be available during agreed Australian business hours to support our site crews and clients.



Pay and progression



Starting rate is USD $8 per hour, with the opportunity to progress to USD $10 to $12 per hour based on demonstrated performance and ownership.



Progression will depend on results, attention to detail and your ability to manage projects independently and improve how we work.



The position is available to start immediately.



Project management responsibilities



• Manage approximately 40 active projects at different stages, from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

• Maintain accurate project records, tasks, responsibilities and follow ups in Pipedrive and ServiceM8.

• Coordinate engineering, estimating, procurement, installation and accounts.

• Track schedules, manufacturing, deliveries, installation dates and deadlines.

• Follow up on drawing approvals, purchase orders, outstanding information and client decisions.

• Track budgets, costs, variations and payment milestones. Ensure changes are recorded and the required approvals are obtained.

• Coordinate invoicing with accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.

• Lead project meetings, assign actions and make sure agreed tasks are completed.

• Identify delays and problems early. Resolve what you can and escalate decisions with clear facts and proposed next steps.

• Provide concise progress updates showing priorities, overdue actions and decisions needed.



Quality assurance and project readiness



Your role includes making sure the right checks happen before materials are installed and before work is covered or crews leave site.



• Confirm site teams have the current approved drawings, scope, material requirements and checklists.

• Coordinate checks of delivered materials against approved specifications, including product codes, delivery records and certificates.

• Ensure material substitutions and changes to the approved design are referred to the responsible person for written approval before use.

• Maintain records of required licences, training, insurance, inductions and permits. Flag missing or expired documents before mobilisation.

• Coordinate required inspections and hold points. A hold point is a stage where work cannot proceed until the required check and approval are complete.

• Review daily site updates, photos and forms for completeness. Follow up on missing or unclear evidence promptly.

• Maintain a register of defects, departures from approved requirements and corrective actions, with an owner and due date for each item.

• Before crews leave site, confirm the responsible supervisor has checked the work and any remaining items have an agreed plan and approval.

• Organise completion records, warranties, handover documents and client sign offs.



You will have management support to hold mobilisation or affected work where required checks or approvals are missing.



Technical decisions and engineering certification remain with the responsible qualified people. Site supervisors remain responsible for checking physical materials and workmanship. Your responsibility is to make sure these checks happen, the evidence is recorded and outstanding items are closed.



Improve how we work



We want someone who spots recurring problems and introduces practical improvements.



This includes improving project handovers, material checks, checklists, reporting and document control.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to help review information, prepare reports and identify gaps. You must check the output and know when an issue needs a person with technical expertise.



What we’re looking for



• Proven experience managing multiple projects in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar environment.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to Australian clients, suppliers and site teams.

• Confidence to lead meetings, ask direct questions and hold people accountable.

• The ability to read project drawings and specifications well enough to identify discrepancies and raise clear questions.

• Experience coordinating QA records, inspections, material approvals or project closeout.

• Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload independently.

• Commercial awareness and confidence tracking budgets, variations and payments.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence using project management systems.

• Pipedrive and ServiceM8 experience is highly desirable.

• Confidence using AI tools while applying your own judgement.



We need someone who takes ownership, raises problems early and follows them through. You should not need constant reminders to complete tasks or chase outstanding actions.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to Matt on WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or download links.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your relevant project management and QA experience.

• The systems you have used, including Pipedrive or ServiceM8.

• How you keep track of multiple projects.

• One example of a mistake you prevented or a process you improved.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same chat. Confirm your earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

You must be confident reviewing drawings and specifications, working with Excel and communicating professionally with Australian clients and suppliers.



Key responsibilities



• Prepare accurate, clearly presented quotations, cost estimates and project budgets using Excel.

• Review drawings, specifications, attachments and relevant
 correspondence before preparing a quote or requesting information.

• Complete material takeoffs and allow for labour, freight, travel, accommodation, equipment and subcontractors where requied.

• Identify missing or conflicting information and prepare clear, project specific RFIs. Avoid generic questions or asking clients for information they have already supplied.

• Obtain supplier pricing and confirm specifications, availability, lead times and quote validity.

• Clearl document the scope, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions behind each quotation.

• Check quantities, formulas, rates and margins before submitting quotations for approval.

• Manage multiple enquiries and quote revisions. Meet agreed turnaround times and flag delays before deadlines are missed.

• Maintain accurate pricing records, estimating spreadsheets and enquiry notes in our systems.

• Follow up with clients and suppliers and keep the sales team informed of progress.

• Prepare a clear handover of accepted quotations, including the budget, scope, commitments and outstanding items.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You must be able to understand what a client needs, ask precise questions and write clear, natural
s.



• Read the full enquiry and supporting documents before responding.

• Tailor correspondence to the actual project.

• Respond promptly and make the next step clear.

• Be confident speaking with clients, suppliers and colleagues when a call will resolve something faster.

• Check names, dimensions, quantities, specifications, attachments and pricing before sending.

• Raise uncertainties rather than guessing or making unsupported commitments.



We need someone who can produce work that requires minimal correction. Speed matters, but quotations must remain accurate and complete.



Improve how we work



We want someone who improves our estimating processes as well as handles the daily workload.



This includes maintaining reliable costing templates, improving pricing records and reducing repetitive administration.



You should be confident using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review information, prepare correspondence and improve productivity. You must check AI output against the source documents and calculations before relying on it.



What we’re looking for



• Proven estimating or costing experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar industry.

• Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions and the ability to build, check and maintain costing models.

• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian client.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and project scopes.

• Strong commercial judgement when reviewing supplier pricing, costs, margins and exclusions.

• Fast, reliable turnaround and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

• Confidence using ChatGPT and other technology while applying your own judgement.

• Pipedrive and experience working with an Australian business are highly desirable.

• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to respond, follow up or complete a quotation.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products and estimating processes. You will need to bring strong estimating fundamentals, Excel skills and communication from the start.



Performance will be measured by quotation accuracy, turnaround times, clear communication and reliable follow through.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader estimating and sales role as you develop your understanding of the business.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or links to download your video.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your estimating or relevant costing experience.

• Your Excel skills and the types of costing spreadsheets you have used.

• How you check your work while meeting tight deadlines.

• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering costing, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Lead Inquiry specialist
description:
# Do You Have Excellent English-Speaking Skills?



## Are You a Sales-Minded People Person Who Thrives on the Phone?



**Our Agency is looking for a Lead Inquiry Specialist to manage a high volume of incoming calls, connect with prospective clients and families, and turn inquiries into opportunities.**



This is not a passive call-answering position. We’re looking for someone who is confident, personable, sales-minded, and comfortable taking ownership of every inquiry that comes their way.



You’ll often be the **first voice a potential client or family hears**, so your ability to build rapport quickly, ask the right questions, communicate value, and confidently move the conversation toward the next step is critical.



If you’re a self-starter who loves talking to people, knows how to sell without sounding scripted, and can keep up in a fast-moving environment, we want to hear from you.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



As our **Lead Inquiry Specialist**, you’ll be responsible for answering a **very high volume of incoming calls and inquiries** from prospective clients, families, referral sources, and others interested in Home Care services.



Your goal isn’t simply to answer the phone — it’s to create an exceptional first impression, understand what the caller needs, communicate how we can help, and move qualified leads forward.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Answering a high volume of incoming calls promptly, professionally, and confidently

• Speaking with prospective clients and family members about their home care needs

• Using a consultative sales approach to build rapport, uncover needs, overcome objections, and move inquiries toward the next step

• Accurately entering, updating, and managing lead information in **Salesforce**

• Working within **WellSky** to review client information and support the inquiry and intake process

• Following up consistently with leads who are not ready to move forward immediately

• Maintaining detailed and accurate documentation of every interaction

• Prioritizing leads and recognizing which inquiries require immediate attention

• Communicating effectively with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from inquiry to consultation and start of care

• Taking ownership of leads rather than waiting to be told what needs to happen next

• Managing multiple conversations, systems, and priorities without sacrificing accuracy or customer service



## What You Bring to the Role



• **Excellent English-speaking and communication skills are required**

• **Previous Salesforce experience is required**

• **Previous WellSky experience is required**

• Previous **sales experience is required**, preferably in phone sales, inside sales, healthcare, home care, senior care, or another service-based industry

• You are extremely comfortable spending the majority of your day on the phone

• You can confidently handle a **high volume of incoming calls** while making each caller feel heard and valued

• You are a self-starter who takes initiative and doesn’t need constant direction

• You understand how to build rapport and guide a conversation toward a decision

• You are comfortable asking questions, addressing concerns, and following up until there is a clear outcome

• You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to document information accurately while speaking with callers

• You can move quickly between Salesforce,
, and other systems

• You remain professional and composed when callers are emotional, stressed, or uncertain

• You understand that **speed, follow-up, and consistency matter in sales**

• You are dependable and take ownership of your responsibilities



## What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who sees an incoming inquiry as more than another phone call.



Every call represents a person or family looking for help — and potentially a new client for our organization. The right person understands how to balance **compassion with sales**, creating a genuine connection while confidently moving the conversation forward.



You should be competitive enough to want to convert leads, compassionate enough to understand the families calling us, and organized enough to make sure **no opportunity falls through the cracks.**



### To Be Considered



Please upload:



• Your current resume

• A brief introduction video telling us about your experience with **sales, Salesforce, and high-volume phone calls**

Laura

title: YouTube Video Podcast Editor
description:
Role (Overview of the Position)

Fertility Friday Publishing — a High-Level Women's Health and Fertility Coaching Business — is looking for a skilled YouTube Video Podcast Editor to join our content production team on a per-video basis.



We are launching a video podcast on YouTube and need an editor who can take raw podcast recordings and turn them into polished, professional, engaging video episodes. Our episodes will be 10 to 20 minutes and will feature multi-camera setups.



This is an execution-focused, deliverable-based role. You will receive raw footage, audio files, and creative direction, and you will deliver completed, publish-ready YouTube videos on a consistent schedule. Thoughtful creative input is welcome — if you see a way to make the final product better, we want to hear it — but the heart of this role is reliable, high-quality editing output, not strategy or content planning.



It's a great fit for someone who takes pride in clean, professional edits, has a sharp eye for pacing and visual quality, delivers on time without reminders, and enjoys the craft of making videos that hold a viewer's attention.



Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

- Editing raw podcast video recordings (10–20 minutes) into polished, publish-ready YouTube episodes.

- Seamlessly syncing and cutting between multiple camera angles to create a dynamic, professional viewing experience.

- Syncing audio and video tracks cleanly, ensuring perfect alignment throughout.

- Adding on-brand graphics, lower thirds, text overlays, background images, and visual elements that enhance the content without cluttering it.

- Creating and maintaining a branded video intro (approximately 15–30 seconds) and outro, and applying them consistently across episodes.

- Color correcting and adjusting footage for a clean, consistent visual quality.

- Exporting final videos in YouTube-optimized formats and specs.

- Incorporating revision notes promptly and accurately.

- Designing eye-catching YouTube thumbnails for each episode that are on-brand, visually compelling, and optimized for click-through (strong plus — not required, but a significant advantage).

- Communicating any issues, questions, or delays proactively — before the deadline, not after.



Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing podcast or interview-style videos for YouTube — this is non-negotiable. We need someone who already knows how to edit this content format and can demonstrate it.

- Proficient in professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent).

- Demonstrated skill with multi-camera editing — syncing, cutting between angles, and maintaining a natural flow.

- Competent with motion graphics, text overlays, lower thirds, and visual enhancements (After Effects, Canva, or similar tools are a plus).

- Strong audio-video sync skills and basic audio cleanup ability.

- Reliable and accountable — you meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and own your work, including mistakes.

- A try-first problem-solver — when something is unclear, you make a reasonable attempt or do your own research before asking, and when you do ask, the question is specific.

- Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revision notes without taking it personally — you see revisions as part of producing great work.

- Fluent enough in written English for clear communication via
 and project management tools.

- Experience with YouTube upload specs, formats, and best practices.

- Experience designing YouTube thumbnails (Canva, Photoshop, or similar) is a strong plus — if you can deliver both the edit and the thumbnail, that's a significant advantage.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools is a plus, but not required.





What We're Not Looking For:

This role is not a fit if you:

- Have experience only with short-form social media clips (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) but not long-form YouTube video editing.

- Prefer to work without deadlines or structured feedback cycles.

- Are looking for a strategy or creative director role — this is hands-on editing work.

- Cannot provide links to published YouTube videos you have edited.



How Success is Measured in this Role:

- Turnaround Time — Completed edits are delivered within the agreed timeframe, consistently and without reminders.

- Edit Quality — Videos are polished, cuts are clean and natural, audio is perfectly synced, graphics are on-brand, and the final product looks professional upon first delivery.

- Responsiveness & Communication — Messages are replied to within 24 hours. Blockers, delays, or questions are raised proactively and specifically — before the deadline is missed, not after.

- Revision Turnaround — Revision notes are incorporated accurately and returned promptly, without the same corrections needing to be repeated.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

- Complete the application form (all questions completed): 

- Link to your CV / resume.

- Links to 1–2 YouTube channels or specific YouTube videos where you did the editing. This is required. We want to see your actual published work — the quality, pacing, graphics, and camera-angle cuts in a real video. Please link directly to the YouTube video(s).



This description is not all-inclusive and certain activities, duties, or responsibilities may be required of the employee as needed.

Litigation/Pre-Litigation Professionals

STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Depositions

- Help manage inbox communications, prioritize time-sensitive requests, and keep information organized.

- Collaborate with team members to improve processes, workflows, and overall efficiency.

- Take initiative to recommend better ways of doing things.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING TO THE TABLE



**Non-Negotiable Requirements:**

- **Previous experience working in the promotional products industry.** This is not an entry-level industry position.

- **Hands-on commonsku experience is REQUIRED.** You must be comfortable navigating and working within the platform.

- Familiarity with SAGE and/or ASI ESP for product research, sourcing, and presentations.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace.

- Strong understanding of promotional product sourcing, vendor communications, order processing, and production workflows.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- **Recent, positive, verifiable professional references from within the promotional products industry are REQUIRED.**



**Bonus Points If You Have:**

- Graphic design knowledge, including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, or similar tools.

- Experience creating polished virtual mockups and client-facing presentations.

- Familiarity with print production, decoration methods, artwork requirements, and branded apparel.

- Experience supporting sales teams, account managers, or business development.

- A proven track record of improving processes, increasing efficiency, or identifying revenue opportunities.



WHO YOU ARE



You're someone who:



- **Takes ownership.** You don't need to be chased down for updates or reminded to follow through.

- **Thinks strategically.** You understand the bigger picture and how your work contributes to company growth.

- **Solves problems.** When something goes sideways, you look for solutions, not excuses.

- **Thinks creatively.** You can take a basic request and find a way to make it better.

- **Is proactive.** You don't wait for opportunities to land in your inbox. You look for them.

- **Is a team player.** You communicate, collaborate, and genuinely want the entire team to succeed.

- **Pays attention to details.** You understand that small mistakes can create big problems in this industry.

- **Has a growth mindset.** You're excited to learn, improve, and take on more responsibility.



Most importantly, you care about doing great work and take pride in the results.



THE OPPORTUNITY

**Growth Potential:** This position has the opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on demonstrated skills, performance, reliability, and business needs.

We're looking for someone who can hit the ground running, bring ideas to the table, and help us make great things happen.

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Cold & Warm Calling  (Remote, Full-Time/Part-Time)
description:
Company: Harvest Panel Systems (Harvest Panels) — Oklahoma, USA Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, US Central Time business hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT)  - Pay $8 base + commission/bonus



About Us

Harvest Panel Systems distributes insulated metal panels (IMPs), cooler doors and trim from Oklahoma to customers across the US. We serve contractors, builders and owners of cold storage facilities, walk-in coolers and freezers, cultivation and grow rooms, food processing plants, cleanrooms and metal buildings. Our panels are in stock and ship nationwide.



The Role

You will be the voice of Harvest Panels on the phone. You will make outbound cold calls, call warm leads from our
 campaigns and website, and follow up on quotes until they close. You will work hand-in-hand with our
 campaign specialist so every lead gets the right call at the right time. Because you will speak directly with American contractors and business owners, perfect spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent is essential.



Responsibilities

• Make 60–100+ outbound calls per day to contractors, builders and facility owners

• Call warm leads who opened, clicked or replied to our
 campaigns, and inbound web inquiries

• Follow up on sent quotes, estimates and past conversations

• Qualify leads: project type, size (square footage), timeline, location and decision-maker

• Book calls and estimate requests for our sales team; collect floor plans and project details

• Log every call, outcome, note and next step in Pipedrive (our CRM) the same day

• Coordinate with the
 specialist on timing, talk tracks and lead priorities

• Leave clear, professional voi
s and send short follow-up
s after calls

• Report daily call numbers and weekly results (connects, conversations, appointments, quotes)



Requirements

• Native-level spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent — this is the #1 requirement

• 2+ years of outbound sales or cold-calling experience for US clients (B2B strongly preferred)

• Confident, friendly and persistent; comfortable handling objections and rejection

• CRM experience; Pipedrive preferred (HubSpot or Salesforce also considered)

• Able to learn technical product details (panel thickness, R-values, door types) and explain them simply

• High-quality USB headset with noise cancelling, quiet workspace, reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power/internet

• Available to work US Central Time business hours



Nice to Have

• Experience selling construction, building materials, HVAC/refrigeration or industrial products

• Experience with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, JustCall, Kixie or similar)



How to Apply

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume

2. Links to your website, portfolio or LinkedIn (if applicable)

3. A short list of past work and projects you have handled (company or industry, your role, and results if available)

4. A voice recording (MP3 or a Vocaroo/Google Drive link) of you reading the script below in a natural, conversational sales tone. Do not use any audio editing or filters. Record in one take, 1–2 minutes

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available start date



Voice Recording Script (for Job Ad 2 applicants)

Applicants read this aloud as if on a live cold call. It runs about 90 seconds and includes product terms, numbers, US place names and an objection, so you can judge accent, pronunciation, pacing and tone.

Instructions for applicants: Read the script below as if you are speaking to a real contractor on the phone. Sound natural and friendly, not robotic. Words in [brackets] are for you to fill in (use your own first name).



Opening

"Hi, is this Mike? Great. Mike, this is [Your Name] with Harvest Panel Systems out of Oklahoma. I know I'm catching you out of the blue, so I'll be quick. Do you have about thirty seconds?"



Reason for the call

"Thanks. We supply insulated metal panels, cooler doors and trim to contractors building cold storage, walk-in coolers and freezers, grow rooms and food processing facilities. I'm calling because a lot of builders we talk to are dealing with long lead times and rising material costs, and we've been able to help with both."



Value

"Our panels combine the wall, the insulation, the vapor barrier and the finish in one product, so crews can install them much faster than traditional framing. Our four-inch panel is rated R-thirty, and we keep stock lengths of ten, twelve, fourteen, sixteen and twenty feet ready to ship from our warehouse in Piedmont, Oklahoma. Stock orders can usually reach you anywhere in the continental U.S. within forty-eight hours after they leave our facility."



Handling an objection

"Totally understand you already have a supplier. Most of our customers did too. We're not asking you to switch today. We just offer a best price guarantee, so if you send us a competitor's written quote, we'll take a look and match it. That way you've got a reliable backup when your usual supplier is backordered."



Close

"Do you have any projects coming up in the next three to six months? If you can send over a floor plan, our team will put together a free estimate and design layout for you. What's the best
 to send that to? Perfect. I'll send it over today and give you a follow-up call on Thursday. Thanks for your time, Mike, and have a great afternoon."

title: TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager
description:
TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Long-Term



Magic Nights Publishing is a U.S.-based children's book company looking for a hands-on TikTok Ads & Ecommerce Marketing Manager to help us grow book sales.



TikTok is our primary digital sales channel, so hands-on TikTok Ads experience is REQUIRED for this position.

We're looking for someone who has actually worked inside TikTok Ads Manager: creating TikTok content, launching campaigns, testing creative, managing audiences, monitoring performance, optimizing campaigns, and using results to improve sales.

We need someone who understands the connection between creative + paid media + ecommerce + conversion and can help us figure out what sells books.



What You'll Own



TikTok Ads & Performance Marketing

• Manage TikTok Ads campaigns from setup through optimization

• Develop and test campaign structures, audiences, creative concepts, hooks, and ad formats

• Monitor performance including CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversions

• Identify winning and losing creative and recommend what to test next

• Work with existing book imagery/video and create or coordinate new ad creative

• Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and continuously improve results

• Track TikTok-driven traffic and sales

• Manage Meta Ads as a secondary paid channel



Ecommerce & Sales

• Manage Shopify product listings, promotions, links, inventory and sales activity

• Monitor ecommerce performance and identify opportunities to increase conversion

• Track sales by channel and provide simple performance reporting

• Coordinate inventory and fulfillment information with Acutrack

• Prepare ecommerce campaigns for Halloween, book launches and other key sales periods



Content & Organic Social

• Develop TikTok and Instagram content that supports paid and organic growth

• Create short-form videos, graphics, captions and promotional content

• Repurpose existing book content into new creative concepts

• Use paid-ad performance to inform organic content and vice versa



 & Growth Marketing

• Manage Mailchimp campaigns and customer lists

• Develop promotional
s, launch campaigns and seasonal communications

• Identify additional opportunities to grow book sales



The role may also support bookstore/school outreach, events, book awards and other marketing activities, but your primary responsibility is growing ecommerce sales, particularly through TikTok.



Required Experience

You should apply only if you have:

• Hands-on professional experience managing TikTok Ads

• Experience personally setting up and optimizing campaigns in TikTok Ads Manager

• Experience analyzing paid-media performance and making optimization decisions

• Experience with ecommerce or direct-to-consumer products

• Experience with Shopify or another ecommerce platform

• Ability to develop or adapt short-form creative for TikTok

• Working knowledge of Meta Ads

• Strong written English

• Strong organization and follow-through



Experience with children's products, books, consumer products, Mailchimp, Canva, CapCut and Acutrack is helpful but not required.



Who We're Looking For

We don't need someone who has simply boosted TikTok posts or helped create TikTok content.

We want someone who can look at a campaign and say:

What's working? What's not? Why? What should we test next? And how do we turn that into more sales?

You'll have significant ownership over the growth of a small children's book brand with existing inventory, creative assets and products ready to sell.



How to Apply

Please message and include:

1. How many years/months have you personally managed TikTok Ads?

2. Describe one TikTok Ads campaign you personally managed. Include the product, approximate ad spend, your role and results.

3. What metrics do you use to d
 whether to scale, modify or stop a TikTok campaign?

4. Links/screenshots/examples of TikTok ads or campaigns you've worked on, if available.

5. Your experience with Shopify and Meta Ads.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Examples of social media content you've created, edited and managed (TikTok and Instagram)





Important: Please do not apply if your TikTok experience is limited to organic content creation or social media management. Hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience is required. Content creation is still an important part of the role but that must be paired with ad experience as well.

title: VIDEO EDITOR – CINEMATIC REAL ESTATE, SOCIAL MEDIA & AI
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

For a busy Canadian real estate team producing cinematic property videos,

social media Reels, YouTube Shorts, podcasts, and business and branded content. We’re

looking for a talented, reliable video editor for a long-term, full-time (40 hours/week) remote

contractor role with flexible scheduling Monday through Saturday based on business needs.

This is not a basic cut-and-trim editing position. You must be able to create polished, cinematic

real estate videos AND modern, attention-grabbing social content. Strong technical editing

skills, creative judgment, and the ability to use AI video tools are essential.

WHAT YOU’LL EDIT

• Cinematic residential and luxury property tours, listing videos, and property highlight reels.

• Fast-paced Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical social content.

• Agent-led videos, educational content, team branding, promotional campaigns, and business

storytelling.

• Podcast episodes and engaging short clips repurposed from longer recordings.

• Multiple formats and versions for different platforms, including horizontal and vertical exports.

REQUIRED EDITING SKILLS

• Confidently build a story from raw footage, with strong shot selection, sequencing, rhythm, and

pacing.

• Advanced colour correction and cinematic grading, including LOG/HLG footage, consistent

white balance, and matching shots from different cameras.

• Smooth speed ramps, motion blur, creative transitions, masking, and movement-matched edits

that enhance the footage rather than distract from it.

• Music selection and precise beat syncing, layered sound effects, ambient audio, clean

dialogue, and professional sound design.

• Clean branded titles, lower thirds, captions, animated text, logos, property details, and tasteful

motion graphics.

• Confident editing of drone footage, interior/exterior footage, agent-on-camera content, and

mixed-source footage.

• Strong hooks, engaging captions, dynamic pacing, and a current understanding of short-form

social media trends.

• Efficient project organization, reliable turnaround times, and the ability to implement feedback

and revisions.

AI VIDEO & PROPERTY ENHANCEMENT — REQUIRED

You should already know how to use AI-assisted editing tools and be comfortable applying them

to real estate content, including:

• Realistic virtual staging and furniture placement in empty rooms.

• Day-to-night and twilight transformations for exterior property footage.

• Object removal, cleanup, and visual enhancements where appropriate.

• Sky replacements, lighting improvements, and other realistic environment enhancements.

• AI-assisted masking, tracking, rotoscoping, and workflow improvements.

• Maintaining realistic architecture, property features, proportions, and visual continuity. AI edits

must look professional and must not misleadingly alter material property characteristics.

Experience with tools such as Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, DaVinci Resolve, Runway, or

comparable AI/VFX software is welcome. We care about your actual results, not just which tools

you use.

SOFTWARE

Final Cut Pro experience is preferred, but not required. Editors using Premiere Pro, DaVinci

Resolve, After Effects, or equivalent professional software are welcome if their work meets our

standards.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• A portfolio demonstrating BOTH cinematic real estate videos and trendy, engaging social

media edits.

• Strong creative instincts, attention to detail, and consistent visual quality.

• Someone who can work independently, follow brand guidelines, communicate clearly, and

meet deadlines.

• A proactive editor who keeps up with editing trends, AI tools, and new creative techniques.

• Someone interested in a dependable, long-term working relationship.

ROLE DETAILS

• Remote, independent contractor position.

• 40 hours per week, with a flexible schedule Monday through Saturday based on business

needs. Saturday availability is required when needed.

• Long-term opportunity

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer - PHP / Symfony / WordPress / TypeScript / React
description:
# Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer - PHP / Symfony / WordPress / TypeScript / React

 

**Employment:** Full-Time



## Position Overview



We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer who can work across established PHP applications, modern JavaScript frameworks, WordPress, APIs, and complex databases.



This is a hands-on development position requiring someone who can maintain and improve existing systems, build custom applications and website functionality, and turn internal prototypes into secure, scalable, production-ready software.



We're looking for a versatile engineer who understands the bigger picture and can make smart architectural decisions without compromising existing systems.



## Key Responsibilities



**PHP & Backend Development**

- Maintain, improve, and extend existing PHP and Symfony applications.

- Develop custom APIs, integrations, and backend functionality.

- Troubleshoot legacy applications and embedded software.

- Modernize existing systems while maintaining reliability and compatibility.



**WordPress Development**

- Build custom WordPress plugins, widgets, themes, and integrations.

- Develop advanced website functionality beyond standard plugins.

- Integrate WordPress with proprietary applications and centralized databases.

- Create reusable components that can be deployed across hundreds of websites.

- Maintain security, performance, and compatibility.



**Modern Application Development**

- Build new applications and interactive tools using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

- Create embeddable widgets, custom interfaces, and reusable software components.

- Develop secure integrations between modern applications and existing platforms.

- Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve existing tools.



**Prototype-to-Production Development**

- Evaluate functional prototypes created by internal teams using AI-assisted development tools.

- Refactor or rebuild prototypes into professional, production-ready applications.

- Improve code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.

- Collaborate with nontechnical teams to turn working concepts into reliable software.



**Database Architecture & API Security**

- Work with large MySQL/MariaDB databases and interconnected systems.

- Build secure APIs for accessing, updating, and saving data.

- Protect production databases from unauthorized access, inefficient queries, and unintended changes.

- Prevent exposed API keys, unnecessary API requests, and performance problems.

- Implement appropriate caching, authentication, access controls, and database optimization.

- Ensure new functionality does not negatively impact existing applications.



**Product Configurators & Workflow Tools**

- Develop and improve interactive product configuration tools and embedded widgets.

- Work with layered images, product options, assets, and configuration data.

- Improve upload systems, image processing, and asset management.

- Streamline complex internal workflows through automation and better software design.



**Infrastructure & Development Practices**

- Work with AWS, cloud hosting, and production environments.

- Use Git, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Implement monitoring, logging, backups, and safe deployment procedures.

- Maintain clear documentation and scalable application architecture.



## Required Qualifications



- 4+ years of professional software development experience or equivalent expertise.

- Expert-level PHP development with strong Symfony experience.

- Advanced TypeScript, JavaScript, and React experience.

- Strong custom WordPress plugin and application development experience.

- Advanced MySQL/MariaDB and database architecture knowledge.

- Experience building and securing REST APIs.

- Strong understanding of software architecture, security, and performance optimization.

- Experience working with large, interconnected production applications.

- Ability to independently design, build, test, and deploy software.

- Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Next.js and modern frontend architecture.

- AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.

- WordPress multisite and large website networks.

- Custom CMS, CRM, and SaaS platform development.

- Product configurators and image-based interactive applications.

- AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

- AI/LLM integrations and workflow automation.

- Redis, caching, background jobs, and queue processing.

- Experience modernizing legacy applications.



## Ideal Candidate



We're looking for an experienced engineer who can move comfortably between PHP, WordPress, and modern TypeScript development.



Someone who can take a working prototype, understand its purpose, and turn it into a secure, scalable application. Someone who understands complex databases, writes clean code, and recognizes how changes to one system can affect others.



Most importantly, we need someone who takes ownership, works independently, and can help us build better software without compromising the systems we already depend on.

title: Salesforce Adminstrator/Developer
description:
A hands-on Salesforce Administrator / Developer to design, build, and own the automation 

that powers our student and employer-facing operations. You'll step into a defined roadmap of projects—everything 

from goal tracking and pipeline build-outs to LMS integrations and automated student outreach—and turn business 

needs into clean, reliable, well-documented Salesforce solutions. 

This is an ideal role for someone with a few years of Salesforce experience who is ready to take real ownership of 

projects end to end. You won't just be executing tickets—you'll be scoping requirements with stakeholders, 

recommending the right approach, and building it. As you deliver, the role is designed to grow: we expect it to 

expand into automation and systems work across the broader organization. 



What You'll Work On 

Your first several months will focus on a scoped set of initiatives, including: 

• Goal & performance tracking — custom objects, formula-driven metrics, and reports/dashboards for quarterly 

enrollment and team targets. 

• Employer partner pipeline — an Opportunity build-out with record types, roll-up automation, stage tracking, 

and supporting data migration. 

• Risk case management — record types and record-triggered Flows that drive tiered outreach based on student 

risk. 

• LMS-to-Salesforce integration — connecting Canvas externship submissions to Salesforce Cases, with 

routing, deduplication, and employer/account creation logic. 

• Automated student outreach — scheduled
 campaigns with survey integration and write-back to keep 

student records current. 

• Progress-based automation — trigger logic that updates student status as they hit program milestones, with 

rules to respect prior opt-outs. 



Key Responsibilities 

• Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable Salesforce solutions—declarative-first, with light 

code where it's the right tool. 

• Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered and scheduled), custom objects, fields, record types, page layouts, 

validation rules, and formulas. 

• Design and build reports and dashboards that give teams clear visibility into their metrics. 

• Integrate Salesforce with external systems (LMS, survey platforms, and other tools) using APIs, webhooks, or 

middleware. 

• Plan and execute data migration and cleanup, including deduplication and validation. 

• Test thoroughly, support UAT, deploy changes safely, and document what you build. 

• Partner with stakeholders across teams to gather requirements, scope work, and set realistic expectations. 

• Support ongoing org health: user management, security settings, and general administration. 



What We're Looking For 

Required 

• 2–4 years of hands-on Salesforce administration and/or development experience. 

• Strong Flow-building skills and solid command of custom objects, fields, formulas, record types, and page 

layouts. 

• Experience creating reports and dashboards for non-technical users. 

• Comfort with data migration, cleanup, and testing best practices. 

• Clear communicator who can gather requirements, document work, and explain technical tradeoffs to non

technical teammates. 

• Self-starter who can own projects end to end with limited oversight. 



Preferred / Nice to Have 

• Additional Salesforce certifications (Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I). 

• Working knowledge of Apex and SOQL for cases where declarative tools fall short. 

• Integration experience—REST APIs, webhooks, or middleware (MuleSoft or Mulesoft for Flow) 

• Experience with an LMS (Canvas especially) or survey tools 

• Salesforce Administrator certification 



Engagement 

Contract-to-hire · 20-40 hours/week, 3-6 months 

Strong potential to convert to a permanent, growing role.

description:
APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 



Job Title: Controller (Remote Independent Contractor)



Company: Swiftpod (
)



Department: Finance

Reports to: CFO

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time - NO MOONLIGHTING



About the Role:

We are looking for a highly organized, self-driven Controller to own and run the accounting function for our apparel printing and fulfillment manufacturing business. In this role, you will own our financial statements end to end and independently execute and finalize our month-end closing process in QuickBooks Online (plus the company’s proprietary inventory management software), delivering a complete, review-ready monthly financial package to our fractional CFO and the Company’s owners. Additionally, you will act as the accounting and tax team's central traffic controller — building and managing our offshore accounting team (an Accounting Manager and our Accounts Payable function), staying ahead of every tax deadline (you own the deadlines; the tax preparers own the tax expertise), and ensuring company mail is processed. You will report directly to our fractional CFO with a dotted line to the Company’s owners.



This role is designed to quickly replace our outsourced Controller.



Schedule & Location:

Dedicated engagement: This is a full-time role (~40 hours/week on the schedule below). We require your full availability during those hours and are not able to accommodate your other concurrent client relationships or any other employment commitments.

Location: 100% Remote.

First 6 Months: Work hours must align with California time (Pacific Time, UTC−8/−7) from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a 1-hour break so you can communicate live with the US team.

After 6 Months: Upon a successful performance review, you have the flexibility to shift your schedule to a split-shift model: 7:00 AM–10:00 AM and 5:00 PM–10:00 PM Pacific Time.



Key Responsibilities

Own the Monthly Close: Independently manage and finalize the month-end closing process within QuickBooks Online (reconciling accounts, verifying balances, reviewing journal entries, and preparing the monthly financial statements). You are the final reviewer of the books before they go to the fractional CFO; there is no outsourced Controller behind you.

Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare the monthly financial package — P&L, balance sheet, direct cash flow, and flux/variance analysis against budget and prior year — with clear commentary for the fractional CFO and the Company’s owners. Own the bank covenant calculations and lender reporting package.

Inventory & Cost Accounting: Own inventory accounting and cost of goods sold, including reconciliation of the proprietary inventory management software to the general ledger, physical count procedures, and fixed asset accounting (capitalization, depreciation, and the asset register used for property tax filings).

Build & Lead the Accounting Team: Direct, coordinate, and review the daily work of an Accounting Manager and three internal, offshore Accounts Payable (AP) accountants to ensure transactions are accurate, coded correctly, and completed on time. Hire, train, and develop the team as the function grows.

Proactive Deadline Tracking: Build and maintain an airtight schedule for all local, state, and federal tax deadlines (income, sales, and property tax) as well as bank covenant requirements. You must be highly proactive to ensure the company never faces a late filing or penalty.

Annual Review & Tax Support: Project-manage the annual CPA review engagement, prepare and own the PBC (prepared-by-client) schedules, and support our external tax preparers on the federal and state income tax returns.

Internal Controls & Documentation: Design and maintain written close checklists, accounting policies, and documented procedures for every recurring task, including the Ramp approval workflow, so the function runs reliably without single points of failure.

Mail Operations: Ensure all incoming digital mail related to compliance, taxes, and vendor billing is managed, sorted, and processed, either directly or through your team.

Leadership Collaboration: Act as the main accounting contact for our fractional CFO and the Company’s owners, and the primary point of contact for our external CPA firm and bank, providing them with clean, reliable data and accurate reports.

Transactional oversight

o Ensure all cash activity is posted to the appropriate accounts on a weekly basis with a full reconciliation on a monthly basis back to bank statements

o Ensure all credit card activity is posted to the appropriate accounts on a weekly basis with a full reconciliation on a monthly basis back to statements

o Manage approval workflows and payment releases for all AP in Ramp, coordinating final approvals with the Owner



Qualifications & Experience



Essentials: An active CPA license is required. QuickBooks Online power user and very strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience: Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years as a Controller, Accounting Manager, or equivalent role where you were personally responsible for closing and finalizing the books. Traditional manufacturing or inventory-based experience is required (inventory management and cost accounting). Prior experience at a "Big 4: accounting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG) and experience supporting a CPA audit or review are strong pluses.

Management Skills: Proven experience building and managing an accounting team, especially offshore or remote team members.

Work Style: Exceptionally organized, independent, and comfortable working asynchronously with an outsourced executive team.

Fluent English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required, including clear annunciation. You must be completely comfortable and fluent when explaining complex financial data to US- based executive leadership, drafting clear
s, and providing direct feedback or instructions to your offshore team members.



Compensation & Terms:

Relationship type: Independent Contractor

Payment: Up to $4,000-5,000 per month, dependent on experience and qualifications; paid monthly in US dollars (typically via Wise)

Equipment & Internet: Not provided — you must supply your own computer and a reliable high-speed internet connection

Paid Time Off: Paid time off for some major US holidays and certain major local holidays

Perks: 100% remote work flexibility with a structured schedule shift opportunity after 6 months of successful performance.

We handle brokerage, investment advisory, property management and land use for buyers, sellers and owners at the top of the Aspen market. We are a small team with high standards, and we are looking for one sharp, organized person to grow our presence online and keep the back office clean.



The role

Remote, about 20 hours a week, on your own schedule. We ask for one hour of daily overlap with US Mountain Time (between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM MT) and quick replies on anything marked urgent. You will report to our founder and work alongside our brand lead and transaction coordinator. The time splits roughly 60% marketing and 40% operations. The work below is listed in priority order within each.



What you'll do



Marketing (about 12 hrs/week)

  • SEO and blog: research keywords, then write and publish 2 to 4 posts a month on Aspen and Snowmass real estate. Optimize pages and report on rankings and traffic monthly.

  • Social media: plan, design in Canva and schedule Instagram,
 and 
 posts, Reels and listing content, working from our brand guidelines. Tell us what performs and what doesn't.

  • Website (Squarespace): keep listings, blog, pages, forms and SEO settings current, along with our Google Business Profile.

  • Website chatbot: set up and train a chatbot (Squarespace AI, Tidio, Chatbase, Intercom or similar) that answers common buyer and seller questions and captures leads. Keep it current.



Operations (about 8 hrs/week)

  • Google Drive: build a clean folder system with naming rules, templates, checklists and SOPs, then keep it that way.

  • Systems and inventory: build simple, searchable trackers for what we manage: properties, furnishings and supplies, documents, accounts and subscriptions, vendors and contacts.

  • Transaction file support: under our transaction coordinator, keep checklists and deadline trackers up to date so every file is complete. You will not draft contracts or give advice to clients.

  • AI in the business: help us adopt AI tools that save real time, and write down how we use them.

  • Admin: inbox and calendar support, CRM updates, vendor scheduling, research, and FedEx labels and tracking for client gifts and documents.

  • Weekly report: a short Friday note with three headings: done, open, needs a decision.



Your first 90 days



  • Month 1: Google Drive reorganized, naming rules in place, first SOPs written, social calendar running, first monthly marketing report.

  • Month 2: first SEO posts live, website audit done and fixed, inventory trackers built.

  • Month 3: chatbot live and capturing leads, a clear read on what is driving traffic and leads, 90-day review with room to grow hours.



Must-haves

  • Excellent written English: clear, warm and polished.

  • Proven SEO and blog writing, with published samples you wrote yourself.

  • A social media portfolio (accounts you grew or content you created).

  • Hands-on Squarespace experience and strong Canva skills.

  • Daily fluency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).

  • Highly organized, reliable and discreet. You will sign an NDA, use a password manager for all logins, and keep client information strictly private.

  • Reliable internet with a backup for power and connection.



Nice-to-haves

  • US luxury real estate or high-net-worth client experience.

  • Chatbot or AI tool setup (Tidio, Chatbase, Intercom, ChatGPT, Claude).

  • CRM experience (Follow Up Boss, Lofty, HubSpot or similar).

  • Short-form video editing (CapCut, Reels).



Pay

$12 to $18 USD/hour, based on skills and samples (about $1,040 to $1,560 a month at 20 hours a week). Independent contractor, paid monthly. Rate and hours reviewed at 90 days.



How to apply

 1. Start the first line of your application with the word SNOWMASS. Applications without it will not be read.

 2. Links to your social media work and any website you built or manage (Squarespace preferred).

 3. Two writing samples, at least one an SEO blog post you wrote (links).

 4. A 1 to 2 minute Loom (or similar) video introducing yourself in English.

 5. Short answers to these:

    a. Which SEO tools do you use, and what is one result you got (rankings, traffic or leads)?

    b. Tell us about a Squarespace site you built or managed. What did you do on it?

    c. Have you set up a website chatbot? Which tool, and what did it do?

title: Service Dispatcher – Field Service / Technician Scheduling
description:
AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service is looking for an experienced Service Dispatcher to coordinate our field service technicians and help keep our daily service schedule running smoothly.



Dispatch experience is strongly preferred for this position. We are looking for someone who has experience scheduling and coordinating technicians, drivers, contractors, delivery personnel, or other field/mobile employees—not simply general customer service experience.



What You'll Do

As our Service Dispatcher, you'll be at the center of our daily service operations.

You'll receive service calls from customers, gather the necessary equipment and repair information, and coordinate those requests with our field technicians.



Throughout the day, you'll:

- Schedule and dispatch field service technicians

- Assign service calls based on technician availability, location, and workload

- Coordinate routes to reduce unnecessary travel and improve efficiency

- Handle schedule changes, urgent service calls, cancellations, and delays

- Communicate with customers regarding technician arrival times and service updates

- Gather accurate equipment information and details about the customer's service issue

- Verify service requests, warranties, parts requirements, and other job information

- Keep technicians updated throughout the day

- Follow up with customers after service

- Maintain accurate service notes, records, and communications in our service software

- Coordinate with our Service Advisors, Parts Department, and Service Manager



This is a fast-moving position. Priorities can change throughout the day, so we're looking for someone who can stay organized, communicate clearly, and make good decisions without losing track of the details.



What We're Looking For

Strong candidates will have previous dispatching experience, particularly coordinating field employees or mobile service teams.



Experience may include:

- Automotive or equipment service dispatch

- HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or appliance service dispatch

- Roadside assistance or towing dispatch

- Trucking, transportation, or delivery dispatch

- Construction or contractor scheduling

- Field service technician coordination

- Fleet or logistics dispatch



Forklift experience is not required. We can teach you our equipment and processes. What we're looking for is someone who already understands the pace and responsibility of dispatching.



Requirements

- Previous dispatching, field service coordination, or technician scheduling experience strongly preferred

- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone throughout the workday

- Excellent organization and multitasking skills

- Able to manage multiple technicians and service calls simultaneously

- Comfortable making schedule adjustments when priorities change

- Strong computer and typing skills

- Detail-oriented with accurate documentation

- Able to work independently while communicating closely with the service team



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience working with a U.S.-based company

- Automotive, forklift, heavy equipment, or industrial service experience

- Experience using dispatch, CRM, ERP, or field-service management software

- Bilingual English/Spanish



About AAA Forklifts

At AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service, we help customers with equipment repair, maintenance, parts, buying, selling, and trading.

We're a growing team that values communication, accountability, teamwork, and people who take ownership of their work. You'll work closely with our service and parts teams and play an important role in making sure our customers receive fast, organized, and reliable service.



How to Apply



Put SERVICE FIRST in the subject line and answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your dispatching experience.

What type of technicians, drivers, contractors, or field employees did you dispatch, and approximately how many did you coordinate at one time?



2. Walk us through how you managed a typical dispatch schedule.

How did you assign jobs and keep track of technician locations, availability, travel time, and changes throughout the day?



3. Give us an example of a difficult dispatch situation you handled.

For example: an emergency service call came in, a technician was running late, a job took longer than expected, or a customer needed immediate service. What did you do?



4. Have you worked for a U.S.-based company?

If yes, tell us about the company, your position, and your main responsibilities.



5. This position involves answering incoming service calls and speaking with American customers throughout the day.

Rate your phone communication skills from 1–10 and briefly explain your rating.



6. What dispatching, scheduling, CRM, or field-service software have you used?



7. Voice Recording



Using Vocaroo, send us a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and answering:

“Tell us about your dispatch experience and why you would be good at coordinating field service technicians and communicating with customers.”



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Please Read the Whole Job Description Before Applying.



Build your sales career at a growing startup on a mission to transform end-of-life care.



You know how to build trust, handle objections, and close. At Meadow, you’ll put those strengths to work helping families choose cremation services with confidence.



We’re expanding across the U.S. and building the sales team that takes us further. We hire people for their strengths, treat them well, and they stay. Expect paid training, honest feedback, clear targets, and room to grow.





The role

As an Inbound Sales Representative, you’ll listen with empathy and guide families who have reached out to Meadow through their options with clarity and compassion. You’ll own individual sales targets, offer thoughtful recommendations, and follow through to close - helping families make confident decisions without pressure. There’s no cold calling.



Depending on team needs and performance, your work may include inbound calls, returning lead follow-up, and support that keeps the sales process running smoothly.



The conversations can be sensitive, but our teammates often describe the work as deeply rewarding. You’ll bring clarity to an unfamiliar process and help families take an important next step.





Day to day, you’ll:



- Convert warm inbound phone leads through thoughtful, consultative conversations.

- Explain cremation options and pricing, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale.

- Follow up by phone, text, and
, keeping records and next steps accurate.

- Meet sales and quality targets while supporting queue coverage and related workflows.



Who this is for

- Experienced sellers. You bring 2+ years of sales experience and a record of hitting individual targets, ideally closing consumer sales over the phone.

- Strong communicators. Your spoken and written English is clear, warm, and confident.

- People who take ownership. You track your numbers, follow through, and act when you’re behind.

- Steady, coachable teammates. You stay composed, use feedback, and adapt as a growing startup evolves.

- You’re comfortable with HubSpot or a similar CRM and have a workspace that meets our technical requirements.



Extra points for Spanish fluency or experience in high-trust categories such as insurance, healthcare, or travel.



How you’ll grow

Most teammates start as Second Call Representatives, building product knowledge, closing sales, and developing Meadow’s consultative approach.



High-performing Day Shift reps may become eligible for the First Call Representative team after approximately three months. First Call reps receive more inbound opportunities and move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan tied directly to dollars sold.



Advancement depends on sustained results, including conversion performance, customer experience, workflow accuracy, and reliability. It isn’t automatic, but the path is clear.





Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- We’re a real business, built to last. We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years.  We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- Fair compensation with real upside. Competitive globally benchmarked base pay, meaningful monthly bonuses, and a clear path to an uncapped compensation plan through eligibility to our First Call team.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

- Benefits: PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.

- Purpose-driven work: Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

- Compensation: $6-$9 OTE, including base pay and monthly performance bonuses.

- Additional upside: Eligible First Call Representatives move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan.

- Schedule: Full-time, eight-hour shifts on a fixed weekly schedule.

- Days: Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday



Shift starts:

- AM: Start between 6 am-10 am ET

- PM: Start between 11 am-2 pm ET

Availability: Being open to any of these schedules is a plus. Once assigned, your schedule stays fixed.

- Tools: HubSpot, Aircall, Google Workspace, Slack, and our case management system.



About Meadow



At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 90+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.



We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.



Learn more about our global team and apply today.

Use an anonymised existing example or a draft/demo setup for a hypothetical roofing client serving Galway, Ireland. Briefly explain how you would validate Google Ads location and conversion settings as well. Stop before any live publication or spend. No access to our client accounts is needed for this screening video.



We are looking for accurate execution, evidence of results and reliable daily coverage. The agreed scope, schedule and pay will be confirmed with the selected candidate before work starts.

title: Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
About Us

Squad Health provides navigation services and software to US medical practices to remove barriers to treatment — especially prescription access.

Our services include benefits investigation, prior authorization submission, patient assistance enrollment, pharmacy coordination, and patient engagement.

Our team members operate as extensions of provider offices, supporting clinical staff through accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.



Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Prior Authorization Specialist with strong background in US specialty medication authorizations. This role requires reviewing clinical documentation, verifying insurance benefits, submitting medication authorizations, and managing denials and appeals efficiently.



Duties

Verify insurance benefits for drug and procedure orders (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Determine pharmacy vs. medical benefit requirements when applicable

Obtain appropriate authorizations by completing payer-specific forms and clinical questionnaires

Review medical notes, diagnosis information, and treatment history to answer clinical questions accurately

Submit and manage authorizations through, payer portals, fax, or phone

Track pending authorizations and follow up until resolution

Prioritize and manage STAT/urgent requests appropriately

Communicate with MDs and NPs regarding denials, treatment plan updates, and Letters of Medical Necessity (LMNs)

Assist patients with copay assistance or patient assistance programs when needed

Enroll patients into navigation programs and obtain consent

Document all actions clearly in internal systems and case trackers

Participate in team meetings to resolve patient access challenges and improve workflow



Required Skills & Experience

Minimum 2 years of US-based specialty medication prior authorization experience

Experience managing other PA Specialists preferred

Direct experience supporting GI, Dermatology, Rheumatology, Urology and Allergy medication authorizations required

Strong understanding of US insurance plans (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Experience reviewing EMR/EHR clinical documentation

Strong attention to detail and structured documentation habits

Fluent English (written and verbal)

Ability to work full-time night shift aligned with EST hours



To apply:

Subject: Prior Authorization Specialist

Answer these questions in your message:

1. A summary of your relevant experience in United States-based prior authorizations?
